| Hi Peter, it’s Laura.

I know you’re probably hearing from a lot of campaigns right now, so I wanted to take a moment to explain why your early support is crucial in a race as competitive as ours.

Together, we flipped this seat from red to blue in a year when Democrats faced tough losses across the country. Every minute and dollar that our incredible network of supporters invested in this campaign had a huge payoff.

Now, we have another tough race ahead of us.

The NRCC has made it known that they’re coming after this seat with everything they’ve got in 2026 and they’re already launching attack ads to try to protect their razor-thin House majority. Early investments allow us to plan and strategize ahead of time so we can build the foundation we need to fight back.

Democrats can’t take back the House without holding this seat. We’ve proven that we know what it takes to win tough races and I need your continued support so we can keep up our momentum year-round.

[_**The work that we do today will be critical to our campaign’s success in 2026. Can I count on your support so we can defend this seat and secure a strong Democratic majority that will put working families over partisan games and extreme agendas?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108539629/548249683/800699251?refcode=BLU_EM_LGC_2025-05-28_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzIwMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDY5ZjdlMC0xZjNjLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mb-o8vyeiwONVw_GIXoCS7QYZ_71OmTBeFzkOELCgAw=)

Peter,
The next few months will include key fights for the fair maps movement and require our ongoing vigilance (read 5 reasons why below) — **so we’re making a special push to hit 500 more donations by the end of May** , and we hope you’ll [**consider donating to All On The Line**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108539739/548250491/-766669670?refcode=don_aotl_tier1_email_5Reasons_email_20250528-AOTL-Tier1-5Reasons_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250528-AOTL-Tier1-5Reasons_&utm_campaign=5Reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRmNjlmN2UwLTFmM2MtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0zDRTYvfFLDk3EyOaXHyx8ZKCSdWNMeGHAFj__BaOPk=):
1️⃣ **The SAVE Act in the Senate:** Right now, the SAVE Act, one of the most dangerous threats to voting rights we’ve seen in decades, lies in the Senate. All On The Line is mobilizing voters across the country to speak out against this dangerous bill and demand that their senators reject it.
2️⃣ **Ohio Redraw:** In the pursuit of power, some Ohio politicians shamelessly sabotaged a ballot initiative last November that would have created a citizen-led redistricting commission and removed politicians from the redistricting process altogether. Right now, we’re rallying pro-fair maps volunteers and gearing up for this year’s redraw of Ohio’s congressional map.
3️⃣ **Defending the Census:** You can’t have fair maps without a fair count of the population. Our movement defended the 2020 Census from the first Trump administration, which tried to add a manipulative and racist citizenship question that would have meant undercounting communities of color. Now, we’re preparing to fight for a fair 2030 Census.
4️⃣ **Affiliate Litigation** : After a major win in Alabama, where a federal court stopped the state’s efforts to impose an unfair congressional map, the work certainly is not over. Our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation, is also currently involved in litigation for equal representation in Georgia, Texas, Louisiana, and Florida. Any week now, the U.S. Supreme Court could decide whether to overrule Louisiana’s new fair map — we have to be ready to mobilize folks nationwide to keep up the fight.
5️⃣ **Ongoing Work to End Gerrymandering:** There are no off-years and there is no off-season when it comes to redistricting, so we work _year-round, year after year_ to achieve fair maps. With your support, our movement is developing sophisticated mapping capabilities to understand the implications of new maps, building grassroots coalitions, educating the public about redistricting's impact on their communities, holding legislators accountable to their voters, and advancing redistricting reforms at multiple levels of the government.
[**Peter, this ongoing work requires ongoing support, and our fights are only ramping up as we head into the summer. Will you make one of the 500 donations we’re looking for before Saturday’s end-of-month deadline?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108539740/548250492/-766669670?refcode=don_aotl_tier1_email_5Reasons_email_20250528-AOTL-Tier1-5Reasons_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250528-AOTL-Tier1-5Reasons_&utm_campaign=5Reasons&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImRmNjlmN2UwLTFmM2MtZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0zDRTYvfFLDk3EyOaXHyx8ZKCSdWNMeGHAFj__BaOPk=)

name: Kristen McDonald Rivet
subject: Personally reaching out to you
body:
Hi there,
By now, you’ve probably seen the news that Trump’s “Big Beautiful Bill” passed the House and is now being taken up in the Senate.
The fact is, it’s far from beautiful. This bill will raise the costs of healthcare, energy, and food for hard-working families, all while making cruel, unnecessary cuts, just to give tax breaks for billionaires and the biggest corporations.
My colleagues and I in the House are doing everything in our power to minimize the damage, but the fact is, we’re in the minority. That means we don’t have the numbers we need to stop all of these horrible outcomes on our own.
**It’s frustrating, but I refuse to give up, and I'm asking you not to either.**
We can put a check on this administration, but that starts by winning the competitive races that will determine who has the power in Congress. That includes ours here in MI-08.
This is one of the most competitive races in the country – one Donald Trump won by 2% – and GOP dark money groups are already targeting it with two separate attack ads and hundreds of thousands of dollars – a full year before the election.
That’s why I’m humbly asking for your $3 support today. It will take a groundswell of grassroots support to hold this seat.

name: Deb Haaland
subject: A broken leg and 3 options...

body:
A few years ago while visiting Shenandoah National Park, I took a bit of a tumble.
Peter, Deb Haaland here.
A few years ago while visiting Shenandoah National Park, I took a _bit_ of a tumble.
I was hiking up the side of a mountain when I slipped on a loose rock. It was a total freak accident — I couldn’t believe it! But there I was, covered in dirt with a pain in my leg and ankle and three options:
* Get airlifted down in a helicopter,
* take eight National Park staff away from their jobs to carry me down,
* or hike down myself.

**I chose to walk back down the mountain, Peter,** because I couldn’t stomach the idea of taking our National Park staff away from their work, even for a few hours. It turns out I hiked down all that way with a broken leg. I’ll be honest, I didn’t think my leg was actually broken at the time.
The federal workers who care for our public lands have absolutely crucial jobs to do. They preserve and protect our public lands for millions of visitors each year and for future generations. **Donald Trump and Elon Musk have made it clear they intend to auction off our lands to extractive industries like Big Oil. They’ve attempted to fire our dedicated National Parks and National Forests workers en masse.**
As Governor of New Mexico, I will be a fierce defender of our rivers, mesas, farmlands, and forests. I will always stand up for the dedicated workers who serve our communities. **[If you’re with me, will you split a donation to support my campaign and Heartland Patriots?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/88665?refcode=em20250528-8968&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8968%2E614464%2EGT0TLJ)**

body:

Peter,

Early this morning, Laura Gillen voted for the Largest Tax Hike in American history, open borders, and providing health care for illegal immigrants instead of U.S. citizens.

She even voted against quadrupling the SALT cap, which would have provided real property tax relief and helped more than 90% of Nassau County families save money.

Check for yourself by clicking each link for more information.

Here’s what I’ve been up to: • **Fighting for our community** – I joined my colleagues in the Congressional Equality Caucus to re-introduce the Equality Act, landmark legislation that would guarantee nationwide protections for LGBTQ+ Americans in housing, employment, education, public accommodations, and more. • **Environmental justice** – On Puget Sound Day, Rep. I’m proud and excited to protect and restore one of our region’s most treasured and vital ecosystems. **Knocking doors** – I spent some of my time back in the district canvassing for Deb K for State Senate, because we need strong, values-rooted leaders like her more than ever. clean_body: Welcome to the latest edition of Emily’s Notes — updates from Washington’s 6th and Washington, D.C.! | Peter, Welcome to the latest edition of Emily’s Notes — updates from Washington’s 6th and Washington, D.C.! Here’s what I’ve been up to: • Fighting for our community – I joined my colleagues in the Congressional Equality Caucus to re-introduce the Equality Act, landmark legislation that would guarantee nationwide protections for LGBTQ+ Americans in housing, employment, education, public accommodations, and more. • Environmental justice – On Puget Sound Day, Rep. Marilyn Strickland and I announced the re-launch of the Puget Sound Recovery Caucus. I’m proud and excited to protect and restore one of our region’s most treasured and vital ecosystems. Knocking doors – I spent some of my time back in the district canvassing for Deb K for State Senate, because we need strong, values-rooted leaders like her more than ever. And, talking to neighbors about engaging in the democratic process is good for the soul! I posted a video on Instagram sharing more about my recent work in Congress and why I’m committed to supporting local leaders like Deb. • Latino Talks – I was honored to attend Latino Victory’s Latino Talks 2025 event and accept the First Award. Representing our community in Congress is a responsibility I don’t take lightly, and I’m so grateful for the opportunity to celebrate our collective progress and power. I’ve also been working day and night to fight back against House Republicans’ deeply flawed budget proposal and protect programs like SNAP and Medicaid from devastating cuts – but this fight does not end with this bill. Team Emily has also been hard at work supporting our adopted swing district, sending support and strategizing how we can most effectively support Joanna Mendoza flip AZ-06. The Republican majority in the House is one of the smallest in history. If we can peel off a handful of Republicans and help Democrats like Joanna win, we can stop bad MAGA bills in their tracks. = = Thanks for everything. — Emily = | | Paid for by Emily Randall for Congress Emily Randall for Congress P.O. body:
I just filed a lawsuit to protect our global position in STEM research from Trump’s attacks.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250528&t=1&akid=1806%2E1088799%2EBpr4xa)
America has been a leader in scientific innovation for decades. But now, President Trump is seeking to undo our progress by dramatically cutting funding for U.S. National Science Foundation (NSF) grants.
**Don’t worry: today, I filed a lawsuit to stop this attack on the research that powers our future.[If I have your support, will you pitch in to our campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250528?refcode=em20250528-1806&amount=5&refcode2=1806_1088799_Bpr4xa&akid=1806%2E1088799%2EBpr4xa)**
The NSF provides grants for cutting-edge research at American universities, including millions of dollars to schools in California. You can thank NSF-funded research for so many things we take for granted today, like the internet and MRIs.
But instead of continuing our excellence in research, **Trump wants to move us backward by making indiscriminate funding cuts and terminating grants** , with no regard for the consequences.
These cuts would do real damage. California won’t be able to adequately train the next generation of scientists and engineers, especially those who come from underrepresented backgrounds. Our country risks falling behind and losing its position as the global leader in science and technology.
**If we want to keep American universities top-tier, we can’t afford to let this happen.** That’s exactly why I’m taking this administration to court to stop these cuts and protect our leadership in STEM research from Trump’s attacks.
**[If you believe in defending American science, research, and innovation, donate to our campaign to ensure we have the resources needed to keep standing up to Trump’s attacks.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250528?refcode=em20250528-1806&amount=5&refcode2=1806_1088799_Bpr4xa&akid=1806%2E1088799%2EBpr4xa)**

Rob

While stories like this are important in understanding the true impact of abortion bans, if you need to avoid reading details, please take care of yourself. _ Peter,

There is no way to sugarcoat this fact: Abortion bans are killing pregnant people, and the anti-choice Republicans responsible for those bans are doing everything they can to hide that fact from the public.

In Georgia, at least two women (Amber Thurman and Candi Miller) died of preventable infections, after hours in agony, because doctors weren't able to perform the abortion procedures that could have saved them. At the same time, the Republican-majority state government disbanded its _entire, 32-person maternal mortality review committee_ — that's the committee that would have investigated cases like Amber and Candi's and held the state of Georgia accountable for their deaths.

And in Texas, at least three pregnant women have also died trying desperately to get abortion care that doctors were not able to provide due to state bans. One of those women, Porsha Ngumezi, hemorrhaged to death while having a miscarriage in a hospital bed because her doctors couldn't perform the procedure she needed (which is also used to end pregnancies).

Let me say that again: **Doctors are being prevented from doing their jobs because of abortion bans in their states — and their patients are dying as a result.**

Republicans write and pass abortion bans _knowing_ their policies will kill people. It is our mission and our duty to get these cruel, dangerous extremists out of office.

Thank you for taking a stand,

Jessica Mackler (she/her/hers)

body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
RUNOFF TIME:
Endorsing a community champion for San Antonio Mayor
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Gina%20graphic%20-%20Small.jpg]
At TOP, we organize to improve the lives of working Texas families each and every day. We know that WHO is in office is critical to our ability to achieve our vision for racial and economic justice. Our elected officials have the power to pass policies that either lift us up or set us back. So every election is important, and getting out the vote is crucial to ensuring that our elected officials are accountable to US.
That's why TOP is endorsing Gina Ortiz Jones, a proven community leader, in this pivotal San Antonio mayoral runoff.
San Antonians deserve a mayor who will stand side by side with us and respect the rights of ALL communities — no matter our age, race, income level, or which ZIP Code we're from.
Gina understands what matters to our city's working families, and she is committed to championing our priorities — from protecting our rights, to making housing and childcare more affordable, to fighting for good-paying jobs with benefits.
Early voting started this Tuesday and runs through next Tuesday, June 3. Election Day for the runoff is Saturday, June 7.
Find San Antonio early voting locations and hours here. [https://https://www.bexar.org/DocumentCenter/View/4572/Early-Voting-Locations-and-Hours-PDF]
SEE YOU SATURDAY:
Be part of TOP's Bexar County probation campaign launch
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
More people are on probation in Texas than are serving time in every county jail. In Bexar County alone, one in 64 adults are under supervision.
Latino and Black Texans disproportionately face a financial burden on probation due to a combination of factors , including high probation fees, and the added cost of other financial obligations such as drug testing costs, restitution payments, and dependent support mandates. These added costs further strain the financial resources of fellow community members already struggling to make ends meet, leading to our existing probation system being a costly driver of mass incarceration.
Come out this Saturday, May 31, from 11 a.m. - 2 p.m. at the Barbara Jordan Community Center in San Antonio for food and bingo fun with TOP as we launch our probation campaign in Bexar County!
RSVP @ toptx.us/bingo [https://secure.everyaction.com/Tw10BpOCS0mgSyDcXMcmzQ2]
Together, let's fight for a local probation system that works fairly for EVERYONE that focuses rehabilitation and humane community-based solutions.
For more information on this event, email Michael Nachebe ( mnachebe@organizetexas.org [mnachebe@organizetexas.org] ) and Laquita Garcia ( lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] ).
RSVP NOW:
Speak out for fair and equitable disaster recovery this Saturday in Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20disaster%20recovery%20forum.png]
Were you impacted by Hurricane Beryl or last year’s Derecho storm? If so, we want to hear from you! Make your voice heard in Houston’s process to spend federal disaster recovery funds.
JOIN TOP and community allies on May 31 from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Harris County Pct. 1 Admin. & Service Center for FREE community resources and to learn how you can be better prepared when severe weather strikes.
Register for the town hall here. [https://secure.everyaction.com/RbWscnc1gE2YSseD35hYLg2]
Contact TOP's Tiffany Hogue at thogue@organizetexas.org [thogue@organizetexas.org] to learn more about the event.
ICYMI: TOP members join national allies in D.C. to call out healthcare and housing cuts in Trump's budget
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Quintero%20and%20TOP%20in%20DC%20Capitol.jpg]
TOP members from across the state were in Washington D.C. last week with our partners at Popular Democracy in Action to call out drastic cuts to Medicaid and federal housing assistance in Trump's reconciliation budget plan.
Christina Quintero is a Houston-area mom and longtime TOP member who’s passionate about her community. Her family is one of MILLIONS across the country that will be impacted by monstrous Medicaid cuts in MAGA's budget reconciliation package (a.k.a. - Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill”) . This atrocious bill benefits the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working people.
WATCH AND SHARE Christina's powerful words during a press conference at the U.S. Capitol. [https://www.facebook.com/reel/1258954002316481]
While Trump's "One Big Beautiful Bill" narrowly passed the House last week, it faces a steeper climb in the Senate. Stay tuned for updates as we get closer to the vote. Working alongside allies, we’ll keep up our fight against this MAGA legislative attack on working families.
TOP Tip: Affordable summertime ideas for the kids and family
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20father%20and%20child.png]
For many Texans with kids, school just let out for summer. Wondering what family-friendly activities you can do with your little ones this summer to have some fun? Check out this list of low-cost summer activities for young children. [https://parade.com/1245931/marynliles/summer-activities/]
Español
ELECCIONES DE SEGUNDA VUELTA:
Respaldando a una líder comunitaria para la alcaldía de San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Gina%20graphic%20-%20Small.jpg]
En TOP, organizamos para mejorar la vida de las familias trabajadoras de Texas cada día. Sabemos que QUIÉN está en el poder es clave para lograr nuestra visión de justicia racial y económica. Nuestras personas electas tienen el poder de aprobar políticas que nos eleven o que nos hagan retroceder. Por eso cada elección es importante, y salir a votar es fundamental para asegurar que nuestras personas electas rindan cuentas a NOSOTROS.
Por eso TOP está respaldando a Gina Ortiz Jones, una líder comunitaria con experiencia comprobada, en esta segunda vuelta electoral tan decisiva para la alcaldía de San Antonio.
La gente de San Antonio merece una alcaldesa que esté con nosotros y respete los derechos de TODAS las comunidades — sin importar nuestra edad, raza, nivel de ingresos o el código postal donde vivamos.
Gina entiende lo que le importa a las familias trabajadoras de nuestra ciudad y está comprometida a defender nuestras prioridades — desde proteger nuestros derechos, hasta hacer que la vivienda y el cuidado infantil sean más accesibles, y luchar por empleos bien pagados con beneficios.
La votación anticipada comenzó este martes y continúa hasta el próximo martes, 3 de junio. El Día de la Elección es el sábado 7 de junio.
Encuentre aquí los centros y horarios de votación anticipada en San Antonio. [https://www.bexar.org/DocumentCenter/View/4572/Early-Voting-Locations-and-Hours-PDF]
NOS VEMOS EL SÁBADO:
Participe en el lanzamiento de la campaña de libertad condicional de TOP en el condado de Bexar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/MAC%20Bexar%20County%20TOP%20group%20shot.jpg]
En Texas, hay más personas en libertad condicional que cumpliendo condena en todas las cárceles del estado. Tan solo en el condado de Bexar, una de cada 64 personas adultas está bajo supervisión.
Los texanos latinos y negros enfrentan de manera desproporcionada una carga financiera durante la libertad condicional debido a varios factores , como las altas tarifas que deben pagar, además de otros costos obligatorios como pruebas de drogas, pagos de restitución y apoyo a personas dependientes. Estos costos adicionales agravan aún más la situación financiera de miembros de la comunidad que ya batallan para salir adelante, lo que convierte a nuestro sistema de libertad condicional en un motor costoso de encarcelamiento masivo.
¡Acompáñanos ESTE sábado 31 de mayo, de 11 a.m. a 2 p.m., en el Centro Comunitario Barbara Jordan en San Antonio para disfrutar de comida y bingo con TOP mientras lanzamos nuestra campaña sobre la libertad condicional en el condado de Bexar!
Confirme su asistencia en toptx.us/bingo [https://secure.everyaction.com/Tw10BpOCS0mgSyDcXMcmzQ2]
Juntos, luchemos por un sistema local de libertad condicional que funcione de manera justa para TODOS y que se centre en la rehabilitación y las soluciones comunitarias humanas.
Para obtener más información sobre este evento, envíe un correo electrónico a Michael Nachebe ( mnachebe@organizetexas.org [mnachebe@organizetexas.org] ) y Laquita García ( lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] ).
RSVP AHORA:
Promueva una recuperación justa y equitativa ante desastres en Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20disaster%20recovery%20forum.png]
¿Fuiste afectado por el huracán Beryl o por la tormenta de viento del año pasado (Derecho)? ¡Si es así, queremos escucharte! Haz que tu voz se escuche en el proceso de Houston para decidir cómo se utilizarán los fondos federales de recuperación por desastres.
ÚNETE a TOP y aliados comunitarios el 31 de mayo de 11 a.m. a 1 p.m. en el Centro Administrativo y de Servicios del Precinto 1 del Condado de Harris para acceder a recursos comunitarios GRATUITOS y aprender cómo puedes estar mejor preparado cuando lleguen tormentas severas.
Regístrate para el foro comunitario aquí. [https://secure.everyaction.com/RbWscnc1gE2YSseD35hYLg2]
Comunícate con Tiffany Hogue de TOP en thogue@organizetexas.org [thogue@organizetexas.org] para obtener más información sobre el evento.
ICYMI: Los miembros de TOP se unen a aliados nacionales en Washington D.C. para denunciar los recortes a la atención médica y la vivienda en el presupuesto de Trump
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Quintero%20and%20TOP%20in%20DC%20Capitol.jpg]
La semana pasada, miembros de TOP de todo el estado estuvieron en Washington D.C. junto a nuestros aliados de Popular Democracy in Action para denunciar los recortes drásticos a Medicaid y a la asistencia federal para vivienda en el plan presupuestario de reconciliación de Trump.
Christina Quintero, una madre del área de Houston y miembro de TOP desde hace mucho tiempo, está profundamente comprometida con su comunidad. Su familia es una de los MILLONES en todo el país que se verán afectadas por los monstruosos recortes a Medicaid incluidos en el paquete presupuestario de reconciliación de MAGA (también conocido como el “Gran y Hermoso Proyecto de Ley” de Trump) . Esta ley atroz beneficia a los ultra ricos a costa de las personas trabajadoras.
MIRA Y COMPARTE las poderosas palabras de Christina durante una conferencia de prensa en el Capitolio. [https://www.facebook.com/reel/1258954002316481]
Aunque el “Gran y Hermoso Proyecto de Ley” de Trump logró pasar por poco en la Cámara de Representantes la semana pasada, enfrenta una batalla más difícil en el Senado. Mantente al tanto de las actualizaciones a medida que se acerca la votación. Junto a nuestros aliados, seguiremos luchando contra este ataque legislativo MAGA a las familias trabajadoras.
Consejos de TOP: Ideas de verano asequibles para niños y familia
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20father%20and%20child.png]
Para muchos texanos con niños, las clases acaban de terminar y comienza el verano. ¿Te preguntas qué actividades familiares puedes hacer con tus pequeños este verano para divertirse? Consulta esta lista de actividades de verano económicas para niños pequeños. [https://parade.com/1245931/marynliles/summer-activities/]

Los texanos latinos y negros enfrentan de manera desproporcionada una carga financiera durante la libertad condicional debido a varios factores , como las altas tarifas que deben pagar, además de otros costos obligatorios como pruebas de drogas, pagos de restitución y apoyo a personas dependientes. Estos costos adicionales agravan aún más la situación financiera de miembros de la comunidad que ya batallan para salir adelante, lo que convierte a nuestro sistema de libertad condicional en un motor costoso de encarcelamiento masivo. ¡Acompáñanos ESTE sábado 31 de mayo, de 11 a.m. a 2 p.m., en el Centro Comunitario Barbara Jordan en San Antonio para disfrutar de comida y bingo con TOP mientras lanzamos nuestra campaña sobre la libertad condicional en el condado de Bexar! Confirme su asistencia en toptx.us/bingo [] Juntos, luchemos por un sistema local de libertad condicional que funcione de manera justa para TODOS y que se centre en la rehabilitación y las soluciones comunitarias humanas. Para obtener más información sobre este evento, envíe un correo electrónico a Michael Nachebe ( mnachebe@organizetexas.org [mnachebe@organizetexas.org] ) y Laquita García ( lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] ). RSVP AHORA: Promueva una recuperación justa y equitativa ante desastres en Houston [] ¿Fuiste afectado por el huracán Beryl o por la tormenta de viento del año pasado (Derecho)? ¡Si es así, queremos escucharte! Haz que tu voz se escuche en el proceso de Houston para decidir cómo se utilizarán los fondos federales de recuperación por desastres. ÚNETE a TOP y aliados comunitarios el 31 de mayo de 11 a.m. a 1 p.m. en el Centro Administrativo y de Servicios del Precinto 1 del Condado de Harris para acceder a recursos comunitarios GRATUITOS y aprender cómo puedes estar mejor preparado cuando lleguen tormentas severas. Regístrate para el foro comunitario aquí. [] Comunícate con Tiffany Hogue de TOP en thogue@organizetexas.org [thogue@organizetexas.org] para obtener más información sobre el evento. ICYMI: Los miembros de TOP se unen a aliados nacionales en Washington D.C. para denunciar los recortes a la atención médica y la vivienda en el presupuesto de Trump [] La semana pasada, miembros de TOP de todo el estado estuvieron en Washington D.C. junto a nuestros aliados de Popular Democracy in Action para denunciar los recortes drásticos a Medicaid y a la asistencia federal para vivienda en el plan presupuestario de reconciliación de Trump. Christina Quintero, una madre del área de Houston y miembro de TOP desde hace mucho tiempo, está profundamente comprometida con su comunidad. Su familia es una de los MILLONES en todo el país que se verán afectadas por los monstruosos recortes a Medicaid incluidos en el paquete presupuestario de reconciliación de MAGA (también conocido como el “Gran y Hermoso Proyecto de Ley” de Trump) . Esta ley atroz beneficia a los ultra ricos a costa de las personas trabajadoras. MIRA Y COMPARTE las poderosas palabras de Christina durante una conferencia de prensa en el Capitolio. [] Aunque el “Gran y Hermoso Proyecto de Ley” de Trump logró pasar por poco en la Cámara de Representantes la semana pasada, enfrenta una batalla más difícil en el Senado. Mantente al tanto de las actualizaciones a medida que se acerca la votación. Junto a nuestros aliados, seguiremos luchando contra este ataque legislativo MAGA a las familias trabajadoras. Consejos de TOP: Ideas de verano asequibles para niños y familia [] Para muchos texanos con niños, las clases acaban de terminar y comienza el verano. ¿Te preguntas qué actividades familiares puedes hacer con tus pequeños este verano para divertirse? Consulta esta lista de actividades de verano económicas para niños pequeños. [] Copyright (C) 2025 Texas Organizing Project. All rights reserved. Texas Organizing Project 700 S. subject: My story of surviving a terrorist IED explosion

body:
For over a month now, you've been hearing from my husband Mike Rogers, his campaign team, and supporters across Michigan about **[why 2026 is a make-or-break election, why Mike is the right leader at the right time, and how flipping this seat is key to keeping the Senate red and advancing President Trump's agenda.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/IsHusaALCSowOgXapHRKow~~/AAVLBhA~/So9jy08D5ntYL8VnO4WAg2_a5cE94UqNCTbu6IDqgfwzHJo_NeywmA_v3SduJunJmfg1z6us-sHR3ohnoHGQJKvOvio1stnYjhYS-Of8kJ5BLU5J4rENKRItMfrwGukNXENC1QGrW4RzOTAefIPFAZOthdZEHb4TVqx6O6eQCzSvrlNoixKFIPBkXpluS4bqukVtpqeKL07NhIMm6_vp5TCCUtOnedX93b_LhMJAVDX034O89qFSct6NUjbODAjtbeVDodmztJHZDYkPgYphY_L10hUx2cAGzW14ncEC0z9GOsng3HIUNVeUYW-ELQeLqRh8C9iqFtXfBlFqPwVoRRrqmwY9Ynt5jv2KQjfm90XV2Fa3fxdAHHcxDG01xUH03Hrrh6HL92IXepjkdv4fIA~~)**

All of that is true.

Today, I wanted to take a moment to share a bit of my story -- and why I know, beyond a doubt, that Mike Rogers is a man worthy of your trust and support.

I was deployed to Iraq in the height of the conflict in the Middle East while working for the Department of Defense.

Here's a picture of me from back then:
[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/IsHusaALCSowOgXapHRKow~~/AAVLBhA~/So9jy08D5ntYL8VnO4WAg2_a5cE94UqNCTbu6IDqgfwzHJo_NeywmA_v3SduJunJmfg1z6us-sHR3ohnoHGQJKvOvio1stnYjhYS-Of8kJ5BLU5J4rENKRItMfrwGukNXENC1QGrW4RzOTAefIPFAZOthdZEHb4TVqx6O6eQCzSvrlNoixKFIPBkXpluS4bqukVtpqeKL07NhIMm6_vp5TCCUtOnedX93b_LhMJAVDX034O89qFSct6NUjbODAjtbeVDodmztJHZDYkPgYphY_L10hUx2cAGzW14ncEC0z9GOsng3HIUNVeUYW-ELQeLqRh8C9iqFtXfBlFqPwVoRRrqmwY9Ynt5jv2KQjfm90XV2Fa3fxdAHHcxDG01xUH03Hrrh6HL92IXepjkdv4fIA~~)
And on a fateful day, my team and I were traveling through the city of Baghdad. You have to understand that just getting around the region as Americans at this point was incredibly dangerous.

We were told to stay in the middle lane of the highway, to keep as much of a distance between us and the explosive devices that lined the roads as possible. The terrorists were always waiting for their opportunity to attack.

_**[Suddenly-- it happened.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/IsHusaALCSowOgXapHRKow~~/AAVLBhA~/So9jy08D5ntYL8VnO4WAg2_a5cE94UqNCTbu6IDqgfwzHJo_NeywmA_v3SduJunJmfg1z6us-sHR3ohnoHGQJKvOvio1stnYjhYS-Of8kJ5BLU5J4rENKRItMfrwGukNXENC1QGrW4RzOTAefIPFAZOthdZEHb4TVqx6O6eQCzSvrlNoixKFIPBkXpluS4bqukVtpqeKL07NhIMm6_vp5TCCUtOnedX93b_LhMJAVDX034O89qFSct6NUjbODAjtbeVDodmztJHZDYkPgYphY_L10hUx2cAGzW14ncEC0z9GOsng3HIUNVeUYW-ELQeLqRh8C9iqFtXfBlFqPwVoRRrqmwY9Ynt5jv2KQjfm90XV2Fa3fxdAHHcxDG01xUH03Hrrh6HL92IXepjkdv4fIA~~)**_

I can still remember what it was like to have my head spinning, with my ears ringing and surrounded by smoke.

When I finally realized what happened, I was incredibly grateful to have made it out alive, as others in the car next to us were not as lucky.

After this incident, my husband often jokes that when there's a bump in the night at home, _he sends me to check things out and make sure we are safe._

**[But the truth is that my husband, Mike Rogers, is the strongest, most courageous, and honorable man I've ever known.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/IsHusaALCSowOgXapHRKow~~/AAVLBhA~/So9jy08D5ntYL8VnO4WAg2_a5cE94UqNCTbu6IDqgfwzHJo_NeywmA_v3SduJunJmfg1z6us-sHR3ohnoHGQJKvOvio1stnYjhYS-Of8kJ5BLU5J4rENKRItMfrwGukNXENC1QGrW4RzOTAefIPFAZOthdZEHb4TVqx6O6eQCzSvrlNoixKFIPBkXpluS4bqukVtpqeKL07NhIMm6_vp5TCCUtOnedX93b_LhMJAVDX034O89qFSct6NUjbODAjtbeVDodmztJHZDYkPgYphY_L10hUx2cAGzW14ncEC0z9GOsng3HIUNVeUYW-ELQeLqRh8C9iqFtXfBlFqPwVoRRrqmwY9Ynt5jv2KQjfm90XV2Fa3fxdAHHcxDG01xUH03Hrrh6HL92IXepjkdv4fIA~~)**

It takes guts to get back into politics these days -- especially with the folks on the other side gearing up to spend tens of millions of dollars to lie about you and your family in the name of scoring cheap political points.

As a young man, Mike fought cancer and worked two jobs -- one on the floor of an automotive factory, and one in security -- just to put himself through college.

My husband is an Army veteran, former FBI agent, and even chaired the House Intelligence Committee in the tough days after 9/11.

He also has been taking the fight to Communist China -- going so far as to break from his fellow Republicans to blow the whistle on the threats that the CCP poses.

_It just doesn 't get any tougher than that._

Mike is the kind of man that does what is right, no matter the personal consequence.

**[And he is the kind of man that is deserving of your support. Because with Mike in the Senate, you can know that there is someone in your corner, fighting for you and preserving our great American values.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/IsHusaALCSowOgXapHRKow~~/AAVLBhA~/So9jy08D5ntYL8VnO4WAg2_a5cE94UqNCTbu6IDqgfwzHJo_NeywmA_v3SduJunJmfg1z6us-sHR3ohnoHGQJKvOvio1stnYjhYS-Of8kJ5BLU5J4rENKRItMfrwGukNXENC1QGrW4RzOTAefIPFAZOthdZEHb4TVqx6O6eQCzSvrlNoixKFIPBkXpluS4bqukVtpqeKL07NhIMm6_vp5TCCUtOnedX93b_LhMJAVDX034O89qFSct6NUjbODAjtbeVDodmztJHZDYkPgYphY_L10hUx2cAGzW14ncEC0z9GOsng3HIUNVeUYW-ELQeLqRh8C9iqFtXfBlFqPwVoRRrqmwY9Ynt5jv2KQjfm90XV2Fa3fxdAHHcxDG01xUH03Hrrh6HL92IXepjkdv4fIA~~)**
******************************************************[SUPPORT MIKE ROGERS HERE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/IsHusaALCSowOgXapHRKow~~/AAVLBhA~/So9jy08D5ntYL8VnO4WAg2_a5cE94UqNCTbu6IDqgfwzHJo_NeywmA_v3SduJunJmfg1z6us-sHR3ohnoHGQJKvOvio1stnYjhYS-Of8kJ5BLU5J4rENKRItMfrwGukNXENC1QGrW4RzOTAefIPFAZOthdZEHb4TVqx6O6eQCzSvrlNoixKFIPBkXpluS4bqukVtpqeKL07NhIMm6_vp5TCCUtOnedX93b_LhMJAVDX034O89qFSct6NUjbODAjtbeVDodmztJHZDYkPgYphY_L10hUx2cAGzW14ncEC0z9GOsng3HIUNVeUYW-ELQeLqRh8C9iqFtXfBlFqPwVoRRrqmwY9Ynt5jv2KQjfm90XV2Fa3fxdAHHcxDG01xUH03Hrrh6HL92IXepjkdv4fIA~~)******************************************************
Thank you for your time, thank you for your support and thank you for not giving up on politics and our great American experiment,

Kristi Rogers

[](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_F3Urcv8kb9dgIiZ-Kh8eg~~/AAVLBhA~/OyZholw_ytYs_fB2l4MsmOfIDhrqK-muAGVqnAqKUBxPCvc29yYAqEBPjGq_6d_1qX53AVTgEDK-O6DSxSl387tPNso-JXNJswP0PdMbieeQvLoLEKsT8EnVQRNP-gtEkdBn9_4CkgUwOQaUNp8YRw~~)

body:

Dear Fellow Conservative,By now you may have heard that David Horowitz passed away recently. **If you’ve ever read or heard David Horowitz’s work, then you already know: He wasn’t afraid to tell the truth.** **[And today, I want to tell you how you can arm yourself with the truth—in David’s own words—and help us keep his legacy alive for generations to come.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z6n9ep6qdntveed6smj4r58a7gaf8g21ttjuiimo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli64o74cdh2bs)** You see, David changed the trajectory of the conservative movement. As Charlie Kirk of Turning Point USA put it: **“David didn’t just write. He debated. He showed up. He walked into hostile auditoriums and faced down Marxist professors, Islamist apologists, and race hustlers – armed only with truth, moral clarity, and a sharp tongue.”** Now that David is gone, it’s up to all of us to carry on his fight. And _his_ Freedom Center is doing exactly that. To supercharge our efforts, to arm you with the truth, and most especially to honor his legacy, today [**I want to send you a copy of the book that changed everything:** **Radical Son: A Generational Odyssey.**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ziu87c3kbov5nn1p4gt9s0vnal18on6i00kmqbjo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli64o74cdh2bs)
---
| | This is David’s story — from his Marxist upbringing...To his friendship with Huey Newton of the Black Panthers...To the brutal murder that shattered his illusions and opened his eyes to the radical Left’s true nature. Many conservatives call this book _monumental,_ _formative,_ and _one of the most important books a conservative American could ever read._ [**That’s why I want to give you a copy.****All I ask is that you help us keep David’s mission alive by making a tax-deductible donation of $60 or more.**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ztigh7i83ed5aeb00h2s9tvh28fcluj3bh4rqn2o_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli64o74cdh2bs)

If you can give $100 or more, I’ll send you two copies — one for you, and one to give as a gift to someone who needs to hear David’s warning. Friend, my name is Daniel Greenfield and I am the new CEO of the David Horowitz Freedom Center.It was the honor of my life to work so closely with David for years, fighting for his most critical legacy, the David Horowitz Freedom Center. David used to say that his Freedom Center “isn’t a think tank; it’s a battle tank.” And with the help of patriots like you, over the decades this battle tank has become powerful weapon against the left.**But my friend, your support today is critical if we’re going to keep fighting David’s battle—because the radical Left isn’t backing down.** In fact, mere days after David’s passing, the liberal media took to disrespectful smears of his life’s work.A columnist at the _New York Times_ sneered that David “executed a dizzying transit from the extreme left to the extreme right.” And the _Los Angeles Times_ mocked him as a “raspy-voiced provocateur” who relied on “straw man arguments so much that I’m sure the Scarecrow from _The Wizard of Oz_ is wondering where his royalties are.”**Attacks like these are why the Freedom Center’s battle is far from over.** We must take up the torch of David Horowitz’s legacy and continue his fight because the radical Left is only growing more emboldened and more powerful.They encourage college students to violently protest on behalf of murderous Hamas terrorists...They defend criminals who have no respect for our nation’s laws and blame their illegal behavior on “racism”... They scream from the rooftops that we all must accept “transgender” predators and rapists for the sake of “inclusion”...**David saw it all coming. Decades ago.** **[You’ll get an insider look into his realization as you read _Radical Son._](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zgi4qb8s2ikmrj44sttop97bbfegt9ggk6shna70_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli64o74cdh2bs)** As David understood, the radical Left is following the same march to Communism that the former Soviet Union did. And I truly believe it’s only because of David’s work that the modern-day conservative movement is finally fighting the right battle.This isn’t a misunderstanding. This isn’t a disagreement.**This is about stopping the radical Left from DESTROYING AMERICA.** Most conservatives are too scared or too weak to say it. But the Freedom Center isn’t:**Leftists are the extremists. They’re the traitors. They’re the insurrectionists.** The Freedom Center has been at the forefront of this battle — long before the rest of the conservative movement caught on to what the radical Left is doing to our country.And because of how effective we’ve been, we’ve paid the price:
---
* Vimeo and YouTube censored and blocked us from uploading our videos to their websites.
* Left-wing extremists at the Southern Poverty Law Center convinced MasterCard to shut off our credit card processing (thank goodness it’s back on now)...
* Long-time business partners and venues cut our contracts out of the blue.

---
**But we’ve survived because of brave patriotic Americans who stood with us.** People who _know_ what David stood for.
People who _believe_ in the mission.
People who are ready to keep fighting — even now. **[And if I’m describing YOU, then I hope you’ll stand with us today by making a tax-deductible donation of $60 or more.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zc6j59f19jcarr70p16mss99he2d4qrf9kds2rag_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli64o74cdh2bs)** And if you can send back an extra-generous renewal donation of $100 or more, I will send you _two_ copies of this book – one for you, and one for you to give as a gift.This book has changed the face of our conservative movement. So perhaps you have a child, grandchild, friend, or neighbor you could give your second copy to. I truly believe that David’s story is going to continue to change lives – and fuel the fire of our conservative movement for decades to come.That’s exactly what we’re focusing on at the Freedom Center.We have never been more determined to expose the radical Left...Untangle their dark web of money... Upend their propaganda and lies...**And smash their plot to destroy our country.** David’s legacy must be fought for. The Freedom Center is taking up his torch. **[But I need your help to keep his fight going.](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zr4hfra19baitqggmh47j9d2jp123h408iqitgr0_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli64o74cdh2bs)** Thank you in advance for standing with us.

For freedom,

**Daniel Greenfield** CEO, David Horowitz Freedom Center

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgu25j7epebi8u09vhem28qjpl2k8vofl4apfo2g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli66ob6chh2bs) [NO](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9rlncrq6uje606e1bevdtig4c6lopf6jsq0u3eo_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli66ob6chh2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you today...

_What is your opinion about the Supreme Court 's role in our constitutional republic? _

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://info.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1kj506chlnm2pvhqvm2jl0s9g4lu391k3oaac2g_rp22sh2s8i6eob0sli66ob6chh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

The U.S. continues testing the federal digital currency. It could redefine retirement planning, privacy, and the future of cash. **[When the U.S. Gets a Downgrade,
No One Is Safe.](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21534/6374453/0f6a1a0e743669bab87186b8b5c52b443523b8b7/1f70b61faddb6a2b0b18ac3afbad0e29b7da147b)** America's credit rating was just cut again - this time from a AAA to AA+. And it wasn't just Uncle Sam. Moody's has now downgraded **10 regional banks** and issued negative outlooks for even more. This isn't about "Wall Street noise." This is about the **foundation of your wealth, cost of your money, the stability of your bank, and the future of your retirement savings.** Here's what a downgrade actually means:
* ❌ Higher interest on U.S. debt
* ❌ More pressure on the dollar
* ❌ Greater strain on banks already exposed to risky bonds
* ❌ Lower confidence in America's financial system

And when confidence drops... **so do markets.** So ask yourself: Are you really comfortable having your nest egg - your 401(k), IRA, or savings - tied to paper assets that depend on the government's ability to pay its bills? **[That's why banks and more Americans are taking steps to hedge their retirement with real, physical gold and silver.](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21534/6374453/0f6a1a0e743669bab87186b8b5c52b443523b8b7/1f70b61faddb6a2b0b18ac3afbad0e29b7da147b)** Not ETFs. Not gold stocks. Not promises. **Real metals. Stored securely. Held in your name.** **It's about control in an out-of-control system.** [**Download your FREE 2025 Gold and Silver Protection Guide and discover how to:**](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21534/6374453/0f6a1a0e743669bab87186b8b5c52b443523b8b7/1f70b61faddb6a2b0b18ac3afbad0e29b7da147b)
* ✅ Legally move funds from your IRA or 401(k) into physical metals
* ✅ Hedge against inflation, rate hikes, and market volatility
* ✅ Regain control of your retirement

As Charlie Kirk of Turning Point USA put it: **" David didn't just write. He debated. He showed up. He walked into hostile auditoriums and faced down Marxist professors, Islamist apologists, and race hustlers - armed only with truth, moral clarity, and a sharp tongue."** Now that David is gone, it's up to all of us to carry on his fight. **When MTG is upset, the base is upset.**
We have a once-in-a-generation opportunity to save our country and if we blow it we deserve to lose the next election.
That’s why I’m holding the establishment’s feet to the fire in the fight to codify President Trump’s agenda.
The powers in Washington are going to punish me for saying this but let me be clear: I don’t care. I don’t work for the Establishment, Special Interests, or the Corrupt Swamp. **I work for YOU.**

I didn’t come to Congress to make friends, I had enough before I got here.
I came to Congress to deliver for the American people, to truly REPRESENT the interests of **_We The People_**.
**_[And that’s exactly what I’m doing](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/awSq/?__vbtrk=MjkyNDEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkyNDEzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**

But the fight for cleaner transportation isn't over
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3632205/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
---
| Hi Friend,

Last week, the Senate voted, _on behalf of the oil industry_ , to directly undermine the authority of California and other states to set their own rules—specifically, rules that reduce harmful transportation pollution and accelerate the transition to electric vehicles.

Make no mistake: the reach of this illegal scheme goes _far beyond_ the borders of California. **This is a much broader attack on states’ rights** , particularly the right to set their own vehicle emissions standards—an attack that will lead to dirtier air, higher prices at the pump, and more health problems—especially in low-income and historically disadvantaged communities.

While this isn’t the outcome we hoped for, **it means that the work we’re doing to support ambitious action in the states is more important than ever.
**
That’s why we recently helped launch the [**Clean RIDES Network**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3632206/87SdQ4wZ)—a network of over 100 labor, climate, and health organizations working to promote cleaner transit options that curb harmful air pollution, cut costs and congestion for commuters, and connect our communities.

As we strategize with network partners on next steps, we’re also assessing if the resources we have right now will be enough to scale up the state-level policies we know will make an impact as we fight back against this attack. [**Can you chip in $5, $10, or more today to supercharge this critical work to advance cleaner and more affordable transportation options?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3632207/87SdQ4wZ) |

| We may be facing an uphill battle against a Republican majority in Congress that’s determined to derail climate and clean energy progress, but Evergreen and the Clean RIDES Network are ready to meet the moment with bold solutions and unrelenting advocacy.

**Our strategy is clear:** |
---
|
* Maximize the impact of recent transportation wins in states like Minnesota, New York, and Pennsylvania, which will create the blueprint to improve transportation across the country.
* Ensure state leaders invest in expanding transportation options, which could save the average American household $1,678 per year and eliminate an additional 2.26 gigatons of transportation emissions by 2050 (equivalent to the pollution of nearly 600 coal-fired power plants).
* Pair these investments with important reforms to prioritize transparency, fiscal responsibility, and pollution reduction in transportation projects.

## ICE: Suspect in Jet Ski Death Is an Illegal Immigrant
ICE has identified Daikerlyn Alejandra Gonzalez Gonzalez, the 21-year-old woman accused of killing a kayaker on Lake Grapevine when she struck her with a jet ski Sunday, as an [illegal immigrant from Venezuela](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOozAURb8GOiNjbAKFi23osu2W6GE_w9sxGNkvIfn7UeYXpr7S1Tnn332-A0U61r-wo-VXSPOBV4nIjHkuDLlsdDIWDpHWjYHymTLPSiojpBFqnD1QfM-69naRfmxrtO1ND6btje7rzS7etUsvb6YLKLsl4Kgc6H6QUrtBhq4m-zmTRo1tK5VSjTaw9KMzagm9H8JQaYmeOOWGN2R8QQnxnZ6YG5f2OtqN-SxV96dSU6Wm67qakF4fi89eqelRKjWRQ0EeD6ZAWMR_ZFG-SJRHOdFxEUBZhJQdCgceWTg4PHlgFB6BN0Ex4gpR0L7TmuHgUmfrz4tipNLfKi3XHSj-IPHvQj6t-g4AAP__cZGMGg). Gonzalez fled the scene with 21-year-old Maikel Coello Perozo, also a Venezuelan illegal immigrant. They were arrested in Dallas [with a packed suitcase](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFygzAQRL8GOjHiLAkoVKShc9qUjGSd4GIZGOli7L_PkF9It8XO7rz3dZ2ujhKt86d7oOVX3KYVj5KQGfNU2OWy0M5YOCaaF3aU9y3zBBK0kFrAMAVH6T2pOlgvw9DWaNtO9bo1Wpl6sdqbi-wjhk7K7nIz3g8KDaL0LoBEX5M9x6SGoW0lADRKO2-GmwYfTehjXymJgXjLDS_I-HIlpvf2xNzctked7MK8l-ryUcFYwXgcRxO3lzoxzkIF4xkrGL-RRbmTmLPb8UkriuTuKBZi4dYg8s9aZxv2g1KiYrpKyfnhKP298P_cPC38BgAA__8wcXr8) yesterday, and Gonzalez has been charged with second-degree felony manslaughter. ## Bills Passed to Combat Sex Crimes, Trafficking
Three bills aimed at protecting victims of sexual abuse, combating human trafficking, and closing a loophole in the criteria for inclusion in the state’s sex offender registry are on their way to becoming law. **PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's **Mountain Minute Podcast** [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Arapahoe County is under fire after a new investigation revealed it [altered its official 2020 election records](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—with no accountability in sight. As RMV expands its mission to [inform and engage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), El Paso County is pushing back on sanctuary policies by [granting deputies ICE authority](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Meanwhile, Gov. Polis faces backlash over a proposed [$10 million “bridge to nowhere,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and Xcel ratepayers may be stuck footing the bill for a [costly new grid deal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) required by state law.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** A mortgage company is under fire for marketing over $1 billion in [home loans to illegal immigrants](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Donald Trump Jr. helped launch the American Rights Alliance to [defend political whistleblowers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) like Colorado’s Tina Peters. Meanwhile, a Maryland school settled with a student suspended for asking why American flags were missing from classrooms—raising questions about [free speech and patriotism in schools](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** C. J. Garbo argues that [fear-driven politics](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and tribalism are weakening the Republican Party. He urges conservatives to reject outrage and division in favor of reason, courage, and coalition-building.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, May 29, 2025.
– Team RMV
P.S. Still haven't gotten your ticket to the Mountain Majesty Gala? Time is running out! **[Get yours here.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Two CVRs, one pattern: Arapahoe County rewrote its election record, critics say–and no one’s accountable](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Arapahoe County quietly replaced its 2020 general election cast vote record (CVR) in early 2025 – years after the election was certified. The change came without public notice, audit, or oversight. The reason? A Yale professor raised concerns about a strange pattern in the data.
That pattern, according to a growing number of analysts and lawmakers, was more than just strange. It was statistically impossible.
“This is like flipping a coin 3,500 times and getting heads every time,” said Dr. Walter Daugherity, a Harvard-trained computer scientist who presented forensic findings at a press conference held Tuesday on the west steps of the Colorado Capitol. RMV covered the lead-up to the event in a story titled Analyst to reveal altered Arapahoe 2020 CVR at Tuesday Capitol press conference.

**[El Paso County defies state sanctuary push, gives deputies ICE powers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* El Paso County Sheriff Joe Roybal announced plans to join the federal 287(g) program, giving local deputies powers typically held by ICE agents to help identify and process illegal immigrants charged with crimes.
* The decision came alongside news that 16 individuals were transferred to ICE custody, with several facing charges involving drugs or violence. Five others were released before ICE could take custody.
* Sheriff Roybal defended the move as a community safety measure, pushing back against state sanctuary policies and emphasizing that deported individuals have known criminal records, not simply immigration violations.

**[Polis’ $10M ‘bridge to nowhere’ sparks public backlash](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [AXIOS DENVER](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Governor Polis is facing public backlash over a proposed $10 million pedestrian bridge in downtown Denver, intended to commemorate Colorado’s 150th anniversary.
* Critics, including Historic Denver, say the project is unnecessary, violates federal guidelines, and clashes with Civic Center Park’s historic design.
* Despite the controversy, the project is moving forward with a mix of public and private funding, including donations from entities with business before the state.

Not only does that mean exposing the fascist actions of Trump, but selling voters on a populist vision of America that they can believe in. Establishment Democrats on the other hand, they try to sell voters on corporate approved policy wrapped in focus grouped messages.
Enter abundance, the establishment's new vision for America that is absolutely flopping:

Abundance is the name of a book written by Ezra Klein and Derek Thompson that proposes a vision for Democrats to sell to voters in the Trump era. Basically, it's a 2000 era Republican Party policy, calling for elimination of building codes and zoning laws that the authors argue will spur construction of "affordable housing" and create an abundance of wealth in America.
No, seriously, that's abundance and it's been piling up in the smoky backrooms of the Dem elites. So much so, YouGov actually polled voters about it and shockingly found most people think it's stupid.
Since Obama, the Democratic base and the rest of America have been at odds with party leadership, only to rally to their chosen savior in an effort to stop Trump. But, in this dire moment of rising fascism in America, the party leadership has fled while working-people like you and I lead the fight against Trump.
We cannot trust the establishment with the keys this time. To win back our country, we need working-class led organizations like National Ground Game PAC to lead the fight. Not only do we use proven canvassing tactics that actually work, we hit the doors with a populist message that actually resonates.
National Ground Game PAC is gearing up to hit the doors hard in the '26 midterms, playing our part in building a blue wave that will win back the House and cripple Trump's power. But it will be all you and I this time - doing the work abundance Dems can't. subject: Huge news – listen and share!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ted Cruz for Senate
body:
We broke it all down on Verdict.

| | Fellow Conservative, It was a truly momentous week in Washington, and I could not be more fired up.

We're on the verge of transformative victories for the American people...

**The House Ways and Means Committee - that's the tax-writing committee in the House - rolled out their reconciliation bill and it included four of my big 2025 priorities!**

Here's a quick summary of the four bills I've introduced that were rolled in:
1. _No Tax on Tips_ - President Trump made a promise to get this done on the campaign trail and I'm proud to be leading the charge in the U.S. Senate. Finally getting the IRS out of the American people's tipped income will benefit every waiter and waitress, bartender, cab driver, barber and beautician, and everyone who works hard to earn a living on tips.

2. _Spectrum Pipeline Act_ - I've been out front working to increase commercial access to mid-band electromagnetic spectrum. When we do that, we will produce billions of dollars of new investment and hundreds of thousands of new jobs.

3. _Education Freedom Scholarships_ - The House included a version of my school choice bill that would create a federal tax credit for individuals and businesses that donate to non-profit scholarship funds, a reform that will help students access a wider range of educational options. If passed, it will be the most significant federal school choice victory in history.

4. _Invest America Act_ - Years from now, when people talk about the impact our Republican efforts have made, this is one of the landmark achievements they'll talk about. Invest America is essentially 401ks for kids - it would create a private investment account for every child, with a $1,000 seed investment, that will allow for contributions and compound over their lives. This will empower every newborn child in our country to accumulate resources.

The game-changing Invest America Act is the primary focus of Wednesday's episode of _Verdict with Ted Cruz_. I'd urge you to**[listen to this important episode](http://trk.tedcruz.)[](http://trk.tedcruz.)[](http://trk.tedcruz.)** and share it with your family and friends.

And we urgently need your financial support as we work to maintain our momentum to get all four of these critical priorities across the finish line!

[**Please pitch in whatever you can right now to sustain our efforts >>>**](http://trk.tedcruz._rXxQrnpMXPA)

Thank you, as always, for being a valued member of our fight-to-win team.
For Liberty,

Ted Cruz

# MTG goes off on Democrat hack
Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene **[took down self-humiliated Democrat Rep. Shri Thanedar,](https://substack.com/redirect/7a040a2e-5eda-442f-a776-ecd9de2526cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who is on a doomed mission to impeach President Trump largely without the support of his own party, for complaining about swift deportation actions taken by the Trump administration.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/7a040a2e-5eda-442f-a776-ecd9de2526cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

"The Trump administration has repeatedly engaged in activities that conflict with decisions and orders of the Supreme Court of the United States," Thanedar said. "For example, the Trump administration wrongfully deported a Maryland man despite an immigration judge granting him a withholding of removals,..."
The congressman tiredly read off just about every buzzword and talking point the Democrats have used recently to attack the Trump administration.
**[Rep. Greene waited for her turn to return fire.](https://substack.com/redirect/7a040a2e-5eda-442f-a776-ecd9de2526cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** As soon as the chairman said, "The gentlewoman from Georgia is recognized," all bets were off.
"The Biden administration created one of the most damaging national security threats our country has ever faced!" she said. "They allowed over 12 million illegals to break our laws, invade our country, rape our women and children and murder our own people!"
Greene went off, "Now Democrats are protesting every single day for **[these cartel members to be brought back into America!!"](https://substack.com/redirect/7a040a2e-5eda-442f-a776-ecd9de2526cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# Elon Musk steps down from DOGE
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/be8ed547-cb76-4d13-b660-ce09a3c5f871?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Musk officially **[ended his 130-day stint leading the Department of Government Efficiency](https://substack.com/redirect/4098f637-353c-4362-834c-cbbf731b24d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , thanking President Trump on Wednesday as his temporary role as a Special Government Employee expired around May 30, though he said the DOGE mission will continue as "a way of life throughout the government."
His departure came after publicly opposing Trump's massive spending bill - Musk had criticized the White House's "Big, Beautiful Bill" as too expensive and said it would undermine his budget-cutting work at DOGE.
He's expected to remain involved as an adviser despite officially stepping down - Trump officials said Musk will continue in an advisory capacity even though his formal government role has ended, and Musk has been adamant that DOGE's cost-cutting mission will persist beyond his leadership.

# Texas Republican DESTROYS Biden's I.C.E. Chief for horrible border policy, lack of responsibility
Texas Rep. Brandon Gill **[went scorched earth](https://substack.com/redirect/ff1df9ab-4241-49d8-8c99-9a110ca136f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on former President Biden's I.C.E. Chief of Staff for utterly failing the American people, allowing millions of illegal border crossings to occur during his time of service.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/ff1df9ab-4241-49d8-8c99-9a110ca136f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ff1df9ab-4241-49d8-8c99-9a110ca136f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Gill pressed the former I.C.E Chief about his continued defense of the Biden administration's border disaster.
Since Trump's election, Houser has come out in support of his and Biden's permissiveness for migrant crossings, even going so far as to say he's "100% correct" in terms of how he handled his role as I.C.E. Chief.
Gill asked, point blank: "Do you think that we have a better or worse border situation now than we did under Joe Biden?"
"Sir, I believe the border is secure." Houser responded.
"But you were wrong about a lot of other things about what would secure the border. Is that right?"
"No, sir. It's only been a hundred days." Houser said, to which Gill slammed with unquestionable statistics.
"**[Southwestern border encounters are at a 15 year low](https://substack.com/redirect/ff1df9ab-4241-49d8-8c99-9a110ca136f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** under President Trump." Gill said, then calling out Houser for claiming Trump's border policy was "dangerous political theater."
"You think seizing fentanyl at our border is 'dangerous political theater?'" Gill asked, even mentioning recent arrest of Gilberto Avila-Jara, an illegal alien and multi-count child sex-offender.
"These were the kind of people that Joe Biden, and under your leadership were coming into the country." Gill said.

name: Supervisor David Canepa
subject: You're Invited – San Bruno Mountain Day Use Improvement Project Kickoff | May 30 at 1:00 PM
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://us1.campaign-archive.com/?e=c0babbc643&u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=e94a884a92)
---
| |

| | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

We are excited to invite you to a special event celebrating the upcoming San Bruno Mountain Day Use Improvement Project, taking place on:

**Friday, May 30 at 1:00 PM
San Bruno Mountain State & County Park
(Main Day Use Area)**

This important project, championed by Supervisor David Canepa, will bring significant upgrades to the park—most notably, new ADA-accessible picnic sites, a modern all-gender restroom, and an interpretive gathering area designed with community input in mind.
[](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=506c20d894&e=c0babbc643)
Construction is expected to begin in June 2025, with completion anticipated this summer. While some areas will be temporarily closed during construction, the improvements will ensure that the park is more inclusive, welcoming, and enjoyable for all.

We hope you'll join us as we mark this exciting milestone for San Bruno Mountain and our community. If you plan to join us, please send an email or text to Mike on my staff: [mrichardson@smcgov.org](mailto:mrichardson@smcgov.org?subject=Friday%20event%20at%20San%20Bruno%20Mountain) or 415-845-1368. Thanks!

Warm regards,

David J. Canepa
---

Peter,

My name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan **running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor—a politician even more radical than her boss.** I’m requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota.

I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76b2d03469164d6cad17fb3cbd8f28e5&_e=HHAhqGl9lPwD9x00BkSvuGo8In1tmmRvQPMmO9-HXCA9kz39ZvmhobSj8PFr6qP2MlYd1rZraG8A5hODfkhjvOFzGeYrIi2AZ43s6jcHUA7OFGcIm_j_hXa5VqNszTH_zgc0iCbF8mARdI7v1HO8ATSMzr7FOBrBCEslvEnyqcyAt2S_2zwAWomZP0oSdi2n_5e4sHpGOXXVmEFrlpYovGrZ9Etx5Zjw5uMisDdsn9LVPnvvVLyKI154wk6ZLfcwkPn9cAXkANfwopRNawX3-1YTDMgI2njnLUiLQQ7fOLO8mUlg4_vYOhTUl7Hn7519NSHjeySVcgnaDto8odWzphkmKsrG9jsHr_lc3Z1CPObIsp5qRNNK5k426UhS6v5uwPBMrSmtRC-DqP81YWLYT0o778KwvoII8pDEh6hAZbLtzC32OOPozXqX-rxi3jm2)

**I’m starting this race with absolutely nothing** , but because of the enormity of the race's outcome, I figured there is no harm in asking for your help. At the end of the day, my request of you will end in one of two ways:
* 1.) **[you contribute to help elect a former Navy SEAL to the United States Senate](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76b2d03469164d6cad17fb3cbd8f28e5&_e=HHAhqGl9lPwD9x00BkSvuGo8In1tmmRvQPMmO9-HXCA9kz39ZvmhobSj8PFr6qP2MlYd1rZraG8A5hODfkhjvOFzGeYrIi2AZ43s6jcHUA7OFGcIm_j_hXa5VqNszTH_zgc0iCbF8mARdI7v1HO8ATSMzr7FOBrBCEslvEnyqcyAt2S_2zwAWomZP0oSdi2n_5e4sHpGOXXVmEFrlpYovGrZ9Etx5Zjw5uMisDdsn9LVPnvvVLyKI154wk6ZLfcwkPn9cAXkANfwopRNawX3-77HHeM7-c24kyE6nAzrqtprZsl1FGJ_PFGilZYU7drKJI8t2mHFanc0i14wKB80J0CQXD7Pk_HqscGz7T9jyVBNSuBvfW1BqYPfXFd25hC98RC3TY_ES4IiUzeXZok1jlFqCD1OQXLft2h9VbStDQ4w0YXlgxjDQENAySUMv9dJ)**.
* 2.) you read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am.

[**HELP ME GET MY CAMPAIGN OFF THE GROUND
CONTRIBUTE $2 OR MORE **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76b2d03469164d6cad17fb3cbd8f28e5&_e=HHAhqGl9lPwD9x00BkSvuGo8In1tmmRvQPMmO9-HXCA9kz39ZvmhobSj8PFr6qP2MlYd1rZraG8A5hODfkhjvOFzGeYrIi2AZ43s6jcHUA7OFGcIm_j_hXa5VqNszTH_zgc0iCbF8mARdI7v1HO8ATSMzr7FOBrBCEslvEnyqcyAt2S_2zwAWomZP0oSdi2n_5e4sHpGOXXVmEFrlpYovGrZ9Etx5Zjw5uMisDdsn9LVPnvvVLyKI154wk6ZLfcwkPn9cAXkANfwopRNawX3-0hOYknAqkTvo5k3YCQzCgXC1JcxM-9dDHVRhvmFYEN7cHvvWVPLoe6xmdBBftfBarvDHSZp7uJFcmwEvk60M3TbS9JvTtOSu6yDu3eIAmnALyA3jX-2Hxibdb-HiZo_KZ7QMjBJ0HiaZa2dllQuyxmOxnLMhoTLFxYoNkzJ2WD7)
**I’m not a career politician. I’m a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation’s call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks.** I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war.

Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, **defunded our police** , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. **While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe.** This isn’t the Minnesota I grew up in—or the one any Minnesotan deserves.

[**HELP ME GET MY CAMPAIGN OFF THE GROUND
CONTRIBUTE $2 OR MORE**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76b2d03469164d6cad17fb3cbd8f28e5&_e=HHAhqGl9lPwD9x00BkSvuGo8In1tmmRvQPMmO9-HXCA9kz39ZvmhobSj8PFr6qP2MlYd1rZraG8A5hODfkhjvOFzGeYrIi2AZ43s6jcHUA7OFGcIm_j_hXa5VqNszTH_zgc0iCbF8mARdI7v1HO8ATSMzr7FOBrBCEslvEnyqcyAt2S_2zwAWomZP0oSdi2n_5e4sHpGOXXVmEFrlpYovGrZ9Etx5Zjw5uMisDdsn9LVPnvvVLyKI154wk6ZLfcwkPn9cAXkANfwopRNawX3-199cwa_hrcfnm3PGiArqCHCKpRaoWPjI8JMXtYm4US_Pk-VIeXnh27SstgTBfn5W2sNjP1cNCaSjXfjXt6APU1d6ZoktyA36IJIhMuoCztP2A207JXAVn_7dqUMp5bZFkSEupzYL6j1nCc9OMTp8AqVtUs3jff6-q7dBTiwwpx5)
[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76b2d03469164d6cad17fb3cbd8f28e5&_e=HHAhqGl9lPwD9x00BkSvuGo8In1tmmRvQPMmO9-HXCA9kz39ZvmhobSj8PFr6qP2MlYd1rZraG8A5hODfkhjvOFzGeYrIi2AZ43s6jcHUA7OFGcIm_j_hXa5VqNszTH_zgc0iCbF8mARdI7v1HO8ATSMzr7FOBrBCEslvEnyqcyAt2S_2zwAWomZP0oSdi2n_5e4sHpGOXXVmEFrlpYovGrZ9Etx5Zjw5uMisDdsn9LVPnvvVLyKI154wk6ZLfcwkPn9cAXkANfwopRNawX3-7LQl9daGaKjRbtWYphui3kx8LyhrUsS6-mALpANwea9oNVuWiCnxTpV3iOYC4TKaMb3wLcVz9X5CR0F1YY5CvSNPXiIf6whf76WN-yBHAgT1p02eYvjmHYLLPJpQ71JCFoV2-NvM7lZXGou72zhQb0GCTuacqfDuBNf3agCPTY_)

**If you are reading this email right now and you don’t live in Minnesota, then I’m sure you’ll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today—individuals of integrity.**

_**That’s not who my opponent is. **_

We have an incredible opportunity to elect a Republican to the U.S. Senate next year - something voters in this state haven’t done since they re-elected former Senator Norm Coleman in 2002. As a Republican, I know the odds are tough in a state that hasn’t voted red in a presidential election since 1976. But **as a former Navy SEAL, I thrive in tough fights. I’ve faced worse odds overseas and am ready to bring that same grit to Washington.**

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76b2d03469164d6cad17fb3cbd8f28e5&_e=HHAhqGl9lPwD9x00BkSvuGo8In1tmmRvQPMmO9-HXCA9kz39ZvmhobSj8PFr6qP2MlYd1rZraG8A5hODfkhjvOFzGeYrIi2AZ43s6jcHUA7OFGcIm_j_hXa5VqNszTH_zgc0iCbF8mARdI7v1HO8ATSMzr7FOBrBCEslvEnyqcyAt2S_2zwAWomZP0oSdi2n_5e4sHpGOXXVmEFrlpYovGrZ9Etx5Zjw5uMisDdsn9LVPnvvVLyKI154wk6ZLfcwkPn9cAXkANfwopRNawX3-6j3UOGykCXbMhrS3evXuMS42GD7JzHccVCQKrRyIVyO09j5G4qWheuwB0NTvzYTgqSLSRcCFYtiSPMjvlph38-K87Pk5AjNivLazBLP4B6FFCmXGM26Rp0_MSNEf-9bCpZFqTEuGGjxp0bwLhQbfwgBdVzTIjPSnZObk1b-7ARf)

[**HELP ME GET MY CAMPAIGN OFF THE GROUND
CONTRIBUTE $2 OR MORE**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=76b2d03469164d6cad17fb3cbd8f28e5&_e=HHAhqGl9lPwD9x00BkSvuGo8In1tmmRvQPMmO9-HXCA9kz39ZvmhobSj8PFr6qP2MlYd1rZraG8A5hODfkhjvOFzGeYrIi2AZ43s6jcHUA7OFGcIm_j_hXa5VqNszTH_zgc0iCbF8mARdI7v1HO8ATSMzr7FOBrBCEslvEnyqcyAt2S_2zwAWomZP0oSdi2n_5e4sHpGOXXVmEFrlpYovGrZ9Etx5Zjw5uMisDdsn9LVPnvvVLyKI154wk6ZLfcwkPn9cAXkANfwopRNawX3-3N0LAWTnP4Yd5aeG7gRhKmaGkBEBReDCG5uN090cazttwTPvEi0O-zn4uexfW6YgEi-RV_CqfOflN5B3L4s0Z8yK6irIGxOEth9GIbK1fgixj6utN2FxDEiCZxYDpqeM5vfcX5CLl4ysLwX-PP2pYEZJSZcZqcDvfvzuL6u-8GF)
Here’s what I stand for:
* Restoring law and order by supporting our police and cracking down on crime.
* Cutting taxes and regulations to ease the burden on retirees and small businesses.
* Securing our borders to protect our communities and sovereignty.
* Defending our Second Amendment rights and traditional values.
* Stopping the radical left’s agenda that’s eroding the America we love.

You don’t know me, but you know what men like me stand for and our reputation. clean_body: I’m running for the Senate against a politician who, while our streets burned, pushed lawsuits against law enforcement officials | Peter, My name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor—a politician even more radical than her boss. I’m requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota. I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations. I’m starting this race with absolutely nothing , but because of the enormity of the race's outcome, I figured there is no harm in asking for your help. At the end of the day, my request of you will end in one of two ways: 1.) . 2.) you read this email without contributing, but you at least now know who I am. I’m not a career politician. I’m a regular guy from a working-class family who grew up playing hockey and answered our nation’s call on my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after the 9/11 attacks. I joined the Marine Corps to defend our country, and as a Navy SEAL, I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to protect our freedoms and way of life. Unlike Tim Walz, who retired from the National Guard before his unit deployed to Iraq, I never backed down from serving our nation during war. Minnesota is at a crossroads. Under Governor Walz and his lieutenant governor, our state has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent unrest in Minneapolis in 2020, defunded our police , and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and inflation. While our streets burned, the lieutenant governor pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the officers keeping us safe. This isn’t the Minnesota I grew up in—or the one any Minnesotan deserves. If you are reading this email right now and you don’t live in Minnesota, then I’m sure you’ll agree with me that every American must be represented by individuals in Congress who want to build a better version of the America we live in today—individuals of integrity. That’s not who my opponent is. We have an incredible opportunity to elect a Republican to the U.S. Senate next year - something voters in this state haven’t done since they re-elected former Senator Norm Coleman in 2002. As a Republican, I know the odds are tough in a state that hasn’t voted red in a presidential election since 1976. But as a former Navy SEAL, I thrive in tough fights. I’ve faced worse odds overseas and am ready to bring that same grit to Washington. Here’s what I stand for: Restoring law and order by supporting our police and cracking down on crime. Cutting taxes and regulations to ease the burden on retirees and small businesses. Securing our borders to protect our communities and sovereignty. Defending our Second Amendment rights and traditional values. Stopping the radical left’s agenda that’s eroding the America we love. You don’t know me, but you know what men like me stand for and our reputation. So, . This race won’t be easy. The Democrats have deep pockets, and the radical left will stop at nothing to keep this seat. I’m running to serve you, to protect our way of life, and to ensure Minnesota remains a place where faith, family, and freedom thrive. I hope you’ll invest in me right now – any amount will help. subject: We Exposed One of the Worst Conspiracies in American History!
body:
Through the release of the Biden-Hur audio recordings, Judicial Watch’s commitment to government transparency has broken the conspiracy to hide former President Joe Biden’s dementia from the American people wide open.

|
