| Dear Fellow American,

**Through the release of the Biden-Hur audio recordings, Judicial Watch 's commitment to government transparency has broken the conspiracy to hide former President Joe Biden's dementia from the American people wide open.**
And now the conspirators are now running for the hills and blaming each other for what was an orchestrated, cynical and contemptible effort to minimize Joe Biden's cognitive failure, stop Donald Trump and keep the voters in the dark about the mental and physical health of the President of the United States.
_We have made history through the release of these recordings_ ...and [now I am asking for you to give us your support](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74287&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) so we can continue to fight as effectively as we can for you and the American people's "right to know."
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74287&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

Although the corrupt media did not tell you, Judicial Watch filed the first Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit and was the lead plaintiff asking for the Biden audio recordings of his interviews in Special Counsel Robert Hur's criminal investigation of Biden's theft and disclosure of classified records.

In February, a federal court ordered the Trump Justice Department to declare whether it intended to continue denying our request for these audio recordings... _and that order forced the_ _Justice Department to end the unlawful cover-up of these_ _recordings._

The Biden White House, the pro-Biden media and Biden allies in Congress _all lied to the_ _American people_ about Joe Biden's cognitive failure, even after his disastrous debate with Donald Trump last summer. What they did was outrageous!

But now, thanks to the brutal reality of the audio recordings of the Biden-Hur interviews, the lying has been exposed and is on the public record...all because of Judicial Watch's lawsuit!

[I am asking you to join with us and help us today](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74287&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) because the American people urgently need Judicial Watch to _keep working through the legal system and the courts_ to expose wrongdoing and make sure the American people see (and hear) what their government is doing.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74287&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

**There will always be unscrupulous politicians and government bureaucrats trying to keep "we the people" in the dark... _and if Judicial Watch is not there to expose and hold them accountable, who will_?**

_Every investigation_ we launch and _every_ _lawsuit_ we file has very real expenses tied to them, and _we cannot meet these expenses without the help and support of dedicated Americans like you_.

[**Please help us today with your best gift.**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74287&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2) And I thank you, in advance, for giving Judicial Watch and our mission your support!

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

| | The movement to end the Electoral College is making progress,**** friend: Minnesota joined the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact and**Maine's state legislature is working to join as well.** If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. **17** **states plus DC have now joined.** Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now **accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election** and totaling 78% of what is needed to make the popular vote the law of the land. clean_body: We can scrap the Electoral College| | | | | The movement to end the Electoral College is making progress,** friend: Minnesota joined the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact andMaine's state legislature is working to join as well. If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 17 states plus DC have now joined. Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election and totaling 78% of what is needed to make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress. Sincerely,

The American People

name: Brandon Gill
subject: Why I want to give all illegals $1,000
body:
Here’s the new deportation plan.

| | | | |
---
Friend, I want to give every illegal alien $1,000...
**...to leave our country forever.**
When President Trump returned to office, **he inherited the most catastrophic illegal immigration crisis in American history.** Biden did that on purpose - to destroy our borders and import millions of future Democrat voters.
The Department of Homeland Security, under Secretary Kristi Noem, just launched a bold initiative: Offering illegal aliens a one-way plane ticket home — and a $1,000 stipend to take it.
**If you think it’s crazy - think again.**
Forced deportation costs north of **$17,000 per person,** it puts our brave law enforcement officers in situations that could be extremely unpredictable and dangerous, and it spreads their resources thin, leaving other areas of our national security vulnerable.
**Here’s the truth: We need to be prepared to do**** _anything it takes_****to get these invaders out of our country, and back where they belong.**
But the new CBP Home app - a repurposed version of Biden’s “CBP One” disaster - allows us to facilitate voluntary self-deportation for just $4,500.
That’s a 70% savings for taxpayers. And that’s just the beginning...
**For every one household of illegals sent back where they came from, taxpayers could be saved more than $1,000,000.**
I won’t apologize for using incentives to fix what Biden broke. I won’t apologize for saving taxpayer money.
**I certainly won’t apologize for sending every last illegal alien back to where they came from.**
**_[If you’re with me - if you believe in mass deportations, law and order, and putting America First - then I need your help](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ayfJ/?__vbtrk=MjkzMTkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkzMTkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**
**[SUPPORT THE NEW DEPORTATION PLAN](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ayfJ/?__vbtrk=MjkzMTkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkzMTkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**
[SEND THEM ALL BACK ](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ayfJ/?__vbtrk=MjkzMTkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkzMTkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
The radical Left, Deep State, and lying media will do everything they can to smear, obstruct, and block this. They want **_open borders_** , **_law enforcement officers in danger_** , and **_a country we don’t recognize anymore_**.

But with you help, we can fight back. President Trump is leading, DHS is acting, and I’m standing in the breach.
**_[I need your help. Let’s finish the job](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/ayfJ/?__vbtrk=MjkzMTkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkzMTkzOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**
| | _For America,_

ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.
LOCAL CANDIDATE EVENTS
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/lily%20canvass.png]
Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!
Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.
South County Library Parking Lot, 6303 Merriman Rd, Roanoke, VA 24018

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

Join us for a social hour every first Thursday of the month at Leonore Restaurant, 128 Campbell St. SW, 5-7 pm.
Join Roanoke Young Dems! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RYD.png]
Meetings occur on the first Monday and third Sunday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies.

My very best,

I’m Derek Marshall, Executive Director of the Local Democracy Project, and I’m reaching out to you during a critical moment for our democracy.
For generations, Republicans have invested heavily in local and municipal races, capturing city councils, school boards, judges, and mayoral offices.
This strategy has paved the way for their dominance at state and federal levels, and as a result essential institutions are under attack and working families are facing unprecedented economic hardships. Families can’t afford housing, and healthcare costs are skyrocketing.
_It's time we counteract this with a robust, local-focused movement._
**__We must act now to reclaim our communities and ensure our leaders represent the needs of the people.**
******[Let’s take our communities back, block by block, seat by seat. clean_body: While this is great news for our economy, this will likely only embolden Trump’s war on our courts | | Peter, A panel of federal judges just blocked Trump's tariffs, ruling that the President does not have authority to unilaterally issue tariffs. | While this is great news for our economy, this will likely only embolden Trump 's war on our courts. Just recently, Republicans snuck a single sentence into their thousand page budget bill that would limit the ability of federal judges to issue injunctions to enforce their rulings - the same mechanism judges are using to block Trump's tariffs. Trump has continually defied court orders, publicly berated judges who have ruled against him, arrested Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan, and Senate Dems just introduced a bill that would end Trump's authority over the U.S. Marshals who provide security for judges - in fear that Trump could have them arrest all judges in their protection with a single order. Defend Our Courts is leading the fight to save our courts from Trump 's fascist ambitions, starting in Pennsylvania where Trump and his MAGA allies aim to take down three democratic state Supreme Court judges in their 2025 retention election. T he outcome of this battle determines whether or not swing state PA will ever have fair elections again. A little more info about what we're fighting for
#
Peter — here are five reasons why we need your support today:
1. **Working people should be able to run for office.** Too often, the people who can best represent our communities are discouraged simply because they don’t have the network or resources. We’re working to flip the script.
2. **We need strong candidates up and down the ballot, in all 50 states.** In red states, purple states, and blue states — it has never been more important to elect leaders who will defend our freedoms at every level of government.
3. **Corporate PACs and billionaire insiders have corrupted our politics.** Look no further than Elon Musk and his shady Super PAC, which has already spent hundreds of millions of dollars to influence elections up and down the ballot.
4. **Grassroots movements are one of the most effective tools to fight back.** That’s what we’re building together — a people-powered movement to take on the corporate elites, billionaires, and corrupt politicians actively working to strip away our rights.
5. **Your support fuels all this important work.** Whether it’s making a donation today or simply supporting the candidates we email you about when you can, you are playing an instrumental role in our movement to take back power for working people.

Friends,
With the end of the month just 2 days away, we wanted to make sure you saw Jena’s email from yesterday.
There has never been a better or more important time to get involved in this race. Can you donate today to help us reach our end-of-month goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2505-q2-jg-eom?refcode=250529-email]
We couldn’t do this without you, Peter.
Team Griswold
----- Original Message -----
Friends –
We’ve had such a strong start to this campaign, and I couldn’t be more grateful for your support or excited for the future of this race.

Hey Peter,
I’m Congresswoman Summer Lee, proudly representing Pennsylvania’s 12th district since 2023. Look, I'm not here to sugarcoat things: Donald Trump is working overtime to dismantle everything we've built. If his administration has its way, billionaires and the ultra-wealthy will come first, and working families dead last.

| | Americans love Social Security, and what's not to love? You work your whole life, paying in with the promise that Social Security will be there when you retire or if you become disabled. It's provided economic security for almost a century. **So why are Trump and Musk trying to sabotage it?** Trump and Musk's so-called anti-fraud crackdown at the Social Security Administration was a fraud itself. According to a recent report, out of over 110,000 claims reviewed under their wasteful new rules, only 2 claims were found to potentially be fraudulent. **The Trump-Musk scheme is bogging down Social Security payments, and retirement claim processing is down 25%!** Trump, Musk, and DOGE are gumming up the system by wasting your tax dollars and making it harder for seniors to access the Social Security benefits they've paid into over their whole working lives. It's a direct attack on people who need their checks to show up on time. Generations of workers have worked hard and paid into Social Security with every paycheck. We cannot betray their investment or the promise that Social Security will be there when you need it. Last week, in the middle of the night, the House majority jammed their partisan budget bill through the House.

The current bill would kick 8.6 million people off their health care, primarily via attacks on Medicaid, plus another 5.1 million by not renewing support for ACA premiums that will expire this year. **That’s 13.7 million Americans in danger of losing their health care coverage, and nearly 200,000 are in our district.**

Another devastating consequence? **Nearly 40 million Americans, including 74,000 people in our district, are at risk of losing their food assistance.**

Cutting SNAP benefits and Medicaid funding? _**This isn’t what the American people voted for.**_

_[MSNBC]_

**_“Giuliani bankruptcy case dismissed, opening door to creditors pursuing collection”_**
_[CNBC]_

| | I believe that public service and serving our nation is an honorable pursuit that should inspire and attract the very best talent in our country. **That's why I'm proud to be leading my first bill of this Congress alongside my colleague Senator Jeff Merkley to codify the Presidential Management Fellows (PMF) Program and protect it from Trump's partisan attacks and reckless dismantling.** The PMF Program has been a flagship leadership development program in which a few hundred individuals are placed in government agencies each year. I participated in the PMF Program at the start of my career in public service, working in national security and diplomacy at the White House, State Department, and Pentagon. For years, the PMF Program has operated under both Republican and Democratic presidents to lift up merit and align skills with opportunity. **But now, Donald Trump has launched another assault on the federal workforce.** This time, they're gutting the PMF Program – a move that will make it harder for everyday Americans to access competent, effective public service from their government. clean_body: I believe that public service and serving our nation is an honorable pursuit that should inspire and attract the very best talent in our country. | | | | I believe that public service and serving our nation is an honorable pursuit that should inspire and attract the very best talent in our country. That's why I'm proud to be leading my first bill of this Congress alongside my colleague Senator Jeff Merkley to codify the Presidential Management Fellows (PMF) Program and protect it from Trump's partisan attacks and reckless dismantling. The PMF Program has been a flagship leadership development program in which a few hundred individuals are placed in government agencies each year. I participated in the PMF Program at the start of my career in public service, working in national security and diplomacy at the White House, State Department, and Pentagon. For years, the PMF Program has operated under both Republican and Democratic presidents to lift up merit and align skills with opportunity. But now, Donald Trump has launched another assault on the federal workforce. This time, they're gutting the PMF Program – a move that will make it harder for everyday Americans to access competent, effective public service from their government. Even in these divided times, I hope we can show strong bipartisan support for the importance of talent in government and the need to codify this important program in legislation. Team: We must pay attention to President Trump's words, taking them literally and figuratively.Why? When we called out a frightening bill, last known as H.R. 9495, **that already passed the House and would give President Donald Trump broad powers to target his political foes,** a lot of our supporters replied that the bill would only truly apply to terrorist groups and that we were overreacting.Well -- earlier this year, right outside the White House, President Trump said people vandalizing Tesla brand cars would be branded domestic terrorists and "go through hell." We're not condoning vandalism, but it shows how quickly and abruptly Donald Trump will escalate against people he sees as his opponents. So we ask again -- **what would stop President Trump from doing the same to nonprofits like ours?** Or other nonprofit groups that oppose his agenda? Peter, In just a few moments, **[I am going to ask you to make a grassroots donation](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/4513?c0=stb-em-may25.qIHRRA&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_EOM_AC_20250529_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=4735%2E35263%2E9S7rIG)**. I hope you'll give me a chance to explain why this request is so important — especially today. As you may know, when I was a child, I had a severe illness that put me in the hospital for three months. Even though I fully recovered, my grandparents, who raised me, were unable to get me insurance at any price because I had this previous illness. Like over 100 million Americans, I know what it’s like to have the label “pre-existing condition” attached to my care — and before the Affordable Care Act (ACA) was passed, many of us could be denied coverage. So, you can imagine my frustration at Republicans lying through their teeth about this disastrous budget bill, which would roll back ACA subsidies and threaten Americans’ access to affordable health care. They claim that their bill won’t touch Medicaid, but if it moves forward, **14 million Americans will see their health care terminated**. I’ve heard from just a few of the over one million Wisconsinites on Medicaid who could be impacted, and what they shared has stuck with me. Many were worried about how they would keep their children safe without the wraparound services Medicaid offers. Others voiced fear for seniors living in nursing homes who may lose the only roof over their heads. These stories are incredibly powerful, and I’m doing everything in my power to make Republicans listen. Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

I read something in _The Washington Post_ that hasn’t left my mind. **A new study shows cancer rates among women in some of the hottest regions of the world are rising — and researchers are now directly linking it to extreme heat and pollution from the climate crisis.** Think about that. The heat is so bad, the air so poisoned, that it’s changing our way of life and increasing our risk of illness. And yet, while people around the globe are getting sicker, Republican lawmakers here at home are cheering on their _“Big Beautiful Bill,”_ Trump’s latest fossil fuel handout. This ugly piece of legislation would gut _over $500 billion_ in clean energy projects and wipe out tax incentives, along with the historic progress on climate solutions we’ve spent decades fighting for. This is the future Donald Trump wants: big polluters get richer off the backs of working people and families, while the rest of us are left to deal with the consequences. **That’s why this moment is so critical. We no longer live in a world where we can sit on the sidelines and hope for the best.** **[JanePAC is working around the clock to elect leaders in statehouses, on school boards, in city councils, and beyond who will fight like hell to protect our communities no matter what Trump signs into law. clean_body: We need to talk about it. | I read something in The Washington Post that hasn’t left my mind. A new study shows cancer rates among women in some of the hottest regions of the world are rising — and researchers are now directly linking it to extreme heat and pollution from the climate crisis. Think about that. The heat is so bad, the air so poisoned, that it’s changing our way of life and increasing our risk of illness. And yet, while people around the globe are getting sicker, Republican lawmakers here at home are cheering on their “Big Beautiful Bill,” Trump’s latest fossil fuel handout. This ugly piece of legislation would gut over $500 billion in clean energy projects and wipe out tax incentives, along with the historic progress on climate solutions we’ve spent decades fighting for. This is the future Donald Trump wants: big polluters get richer off the backs of working people and families, while the rest of us are left to deal with the consequences. That’s why this moment is so critical. | **Meet Jim:** Congressman Jim Baird is a decorated Vietnam War Veteran and the proud representative for Indiana's 4th Congressional District in our nation's capital. A lifelong resident of West Central Indiana, Jim grew up on his family's farm and had the values of faith, family, and hard work instilled in him at an early age. He is an unwavering defender of America's Constitutional liberties and has spent the vast majority of his life serving our country. After earning both his bachelor's and his master's at Purdue University, Jim was assigned to the 523rd Transportation Company at Cha Rang Valley in Vietnam. He fought in two of the deadliest battles of Operation Lam Son 719 and lost his left arm during a convoy ambush in March of 1971. In a true embodiment of American sacrifice and patriotism, Jim Baird has put his life on the line time and time again fighting communism abroad. His belief in the American Dream and our American way of life go far beyond words. For the entirety of his life, Jim has fought the good fight for our country both physically and spiritually. And he wears his love for the world's greatest country on his sleeve each and every day that he shows up for work in Washington, D.C. Previously, Jim Baird spent eight years in the Indiana House of Representatives serving District 44 from 2010 to 2018. Prior to that, he was Putnam County Commissioner from 2006 to 2010. A fiscal conservative and America First Republican, Jim is incredibly proud to fight every day in DC to advance the best interests of Indiana's families through Congress. A loving husband to his wife Danise, a devoted father to his children, and the world's best pop-pop to his grandkids, Jim spends most of his free time in the company of his loved ones or tending to the family farm.

body:

#
---
Peter — As May comes to a close, I want to share a few updates on the work I’ve been doing this month to deliver for Hawaii residents:
* I joined my colleagues in introducing the _Small Business Liberation Act_ to help **protect small businesses** from Donald Trump’s harmful tariffs that could drive up costs and hurt local economies. Small businesses are the backbone of Hawaii’s communities, and I pledge to stand up for them.

* I marked Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander (AANHPI) Heritage Month and National Mental Health Awareness Month by introducing the _Stop Mental Health Stigma in Our Communities Act of 2025_ to **increase awareness and access to mental health care** for the AANHPI community.

* I commemorated Teacher Appreciation Week by **condemning Donald Trump’s attacks on the U.S. Department of Education** and public schools nationwide.

* I called on Donald Trump and Elon Musk to**get their hands off Medicaid**. Medicaid is not a bargaining chip, and Republicans are working to get rid of this vital program that is a lifeline for millions. I’ll fight to protect it every step of the way.

**It’s been a busy month, and I know that more challenges lie ahead. Hi Peter, Oregon's Bottle Bill is iconic. Since 1971 it has helped Oregon achieve record recycling outcomes while keeping our beaches, parks, and waterways free of littered beverage containers. Last year, Oregonians redeemed more than 2 billion aluminum, plastic, and glass beverage containers. Not only does the Bottle Bill keep beverage containers from being littered—it also makes sure they are recycled. 100% of Oregon's Bottle Bill containers are recycled domestically, with much of that material used to make new beverage containers. But now the Bottle Bill is facing a dangerous threat—one that will directly harm a piece of the environmental legacy put in place by former Governor Tom McCall. The Legislature and Governor Kotek are considering taking the Bottle Bill's unclaimed refunds to fund wildfire management. This disastrous proposal would gut the Bottle Bill's most popular programs like Green Bag accounts and BottleDrop Give fundraising for Oregon nonprofits. These programs have had a direct link to the success of our Bottle Bill and are the reason Oregon continues to have the highest redemption rate in the nation. https://indianacapitalchronicle.com/briefs/hoosier-safety-is-top-priority-gov-braun-signs-public-safety-bills/ [Click Here To Read Full Story](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/NQ_x3FZpFzPCmpqxkOMMrcyzhELgoo3OliReQWyEUUDTDkKTiOXf09ErdNemf5h6pL75SAUFw1tcLGs7puiSExak0X8aAdGFUgpOQbOdSbBLSl1e6uRoKldYw700wTAo-wiz5t97xaVgWUm1j1VislE3xTknPQkaDhO4CR4wKJTtZujUmW5U3s_uQ3TtumN9xZcjIHdbZ8JOPfIL94gnwFz5qsVSjjUNFDaCFNe1nZsQIblEu9NI6x1leB1ckZdKB2P_G4BQ76v9lhJHDhz_H94JqtzF-e0m3oGP4mIbVDjV0htnmWj7VtbsxhJUSwc8Timdc4Xibmnz1vLIydElBZTn8MLo9W9uRjfBSyN6agJ9Zcic7Fh3PVg/nPvQjBpqpGqk52QRUpD0AuJjLfmaHfAV/9) It may have been just a ceremonial signing but Indiana Gov. Mike Braun and advocates lauded two public safety bills Wednesday afternoon. Braun signed [Senate Enrolled Act 324](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/UA8YhfYZqMZZi15EVNh8Mfc5grG6VXvw-qAX5ArAzUtj7aTsYRhp6QXs6yVvATj_dHH1GvNdP7Ngk5gz0KBXWYv__9MAsY-puMpmkoRx4_aVOoGx2KA0MuZz5R1m8cdHzic5nK19T5COLUFni6kzFIT2wltlmXDUTrhwqxsS3yZBZz7ML2zab_cNpjyOjQdI_hihz1gujeAJmcivpGrS9InbP2XkcClNakCJyl-wCdZg-8-o0X2JgKnxftY7g0Dy1rtb2qpLIQkSUJnYyfoUermMsDScD70h5wvfHSMQk7maITkCBthW/F3DUppeUyPOvDkcyEV2QuK8PYWD8kEa8/9) and [House Enrolled Act 1014](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/0XUab82NuODCYex4J5X4ou9Z7As16FXWWe9Vi6tNu1u7Ktozb9Jf7c1QhInfVudmQhTpVfVe7pBIpidGpp754uhjLka8UwA3YITVnsymcpeNqocRoM9522QugvfJoiiXGrJKGd2bTpGJlQ7S0nK9HHEmLZzz9ZcFRObBKt7yrt3Ep0zlfMXP7m3E1KGhtQf3BmhNjQgRfHv4uJkC2UU1DR7fcfUwWl_v9Euzjv6FLiYPMYQyZH9HalJzdSCB7eZdBnFSkM_GLkoCnmaSJFWExkw86W789tQCiLQCSyzY5tU8i0Xb9ExA/HMDi_BKwbF-LevPJNO6v_Nz2TQ7P1W7t/9), both bills to protect Hoosier families as a part of his agenda, he said. “Keeping Hoosiers safe is our top priority, and we’ve secured several wins for public safety this session.” Braun said in a news release. “These bills will increase the penalty for pushing fentanyl on our streets, help keep police officers safe, and make our communities safer for Hoosier families.” SEA 324, effective July 1, increases penalty levels for crimes involving fentanyl. It also states that a court must consider requiring a person charged with domestic violence to wear a monitoring device as a condition of bail. The bill hits close to home for one Indiana family — the Stoebick’s, who attended the bill signing after losing a loved one to domestic violence. Jessica Stoebick, a nurse at Riley Hospital for Children, was [murdered by her ex-husband](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/uZV_gG8lb6rNUeqKqxo5HnfOXliibsocaaRRQ2m8NDQ4CLH0hiKFycszIHlMNkpPUkcm18BKrrxqp8zD1WDxN20Rh5kDQRc11H9XutbPaiTAxbk6p_cl60H-9mDtidZ-GaigWmzU7WhTiHyleycEbudD95dvcRhSBNwNuNRBSGHGXxSjrIzYoTkHqfBDFtwFD0_b8sbk3DTnNbTNQiLqzKCUhDvzgc4cLSgGQNY_Jc4ZVd0eZEydwGA4S1jhF4AXXGnYiiyh0u4Rewufpm8M2_BXWS5ZCv31XL0AU7xZjjTBn-xQdXVR7J30PCCfylc4Wu8o89jswE6fIIO2H7bgg5yEKAhbznAJURdEmJTYRQH47tinH2-o8QdF6aQTB_zgQnKwR7oDIsGBTl3-d2kB_GqhLIqr9PaNk6lif5Lk2tjqBMvadyRaDgekAaA8zvEGNFbmIlXiqcMZwpUeYGrjZ8MW0_I7KqGPNEU-yi3qqS6bGwdWwtfVGoL26_6r3Wucj7wSBayETQ/KoTVTnk-wI-Z70if-dsfpzHgPzLjhkVa/9) after a history of domestic abuse incidents on Dec. 18, 2023. Her mother, Bobbi Stoebick stood next to Braun as he signed the bill wearing a shirt that read ‘I wear purple for my daughter. Stop domestic violence.’ Jessica’s father and sister also attended. Bobbi Stoebick said she thinks that if her daughter’s ex-husband was wearing a ankle monitor, her daughter would have had more time to prepare herself. “It is baby steps,” She said after the signing. “Women live in fear everyday, it has to stop.” Braun also signed HEA 1014, which will restrict government entities from hosting or organizing obscene performances. “That’s just common sense,” Braun said about the bill. “It just isn’t what the government should be spending taxpayer dollars on.” During the legislative session, no examples were provided of any such instances. The law also makes it a sentencing aggravator to be in the U.S. “unlawfully,” as well as having distributed a controlled substance. “There are no disruptions from the federal border,” Braun said. “Things are already getting better.” [Click Here To Read Full Story](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/UxcdKO-iQp8a_klpbykDiOdEQShDTteBYuo4jCZJstva1dh1sOlRW0BHR-PS_542SPF63qEeusUKhQcGAi8SQY9SFfVO-6E-FohU4As_8FfuSi5QJzBskX1sXucJTEgwduwlt2b07egs62DhI0IhGWc1OrRHb9tnuf2PKBZ0TFxaxM7dzD3vnxDUOlAGUs30sF5oa4CkZnf0OdvOH3oubHd4epok-gdOnhgxoGvTAeTNJhhPw9z9n9tsUft8MMZw2ycTcBQSpZG6yjD4HVagtvABlQpvfbvPzR9aOLeEK_LRF1huUdOQOkGrZZQ9rVP2IWnIbClYOuHj3JMOT9ztPmwN3BV-LSB408vgsXfu0DN7owJMjtC1PUM/ocaJZzKaNNa_TbJPWW_Ac8F6gr8fauiD/9)

subject: I am 35 years sober

body:
You must face hard truths if you want to make change.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Deb Haaland.
State Democrats Committee said I could reach out, and I’m so grateful for the chance to connect with you.
I want to tell you about a milestone I’m proud of: **I have reached 35 years of sobriety.**
Most people running for office wouldn’t choose to speak candidly about alcohol addiction. But I’m not like most people running for office. My story is different.
I was about 23 years old when I made the brave decision to get sober. It was a struggle at first, but I persevered because I was committed to doing all I could. I went to AA meetings and probably read 20 books on addiction.
My struggles made me fierce, which is why I chose to speak openly about my sobriety in my very first campaign ad when I ran for Congress, which aired 7 years ago this week. And I’m so glad I did. I'll never forget the day we went to the Marigold Parade in the South Valley, and people came up to me right and left and thanked me for saying that in my ad. They shared stories about themselves, their parents, and their loved ones struggling with addiction, and it brought tears to my eyes that people felt represented by someone like me.
**My journey to sobriety taught me that you must face hard truths if you want to make change, which is why I’ll never shy away from the tough fights that lie ahead for New Mexico.**
Crime, poverty, homelessness, and addiction are weighing heavy on New Mexico, and I intend to tackle those challenges head-on as governor. I promise to be honest about topics other politicians might try to sweep under the rug, because I believe if we’re brave, we can heal.
Thank you for hearing my story, Peter. And I want to thank State Democrats Committee for their support. That’s how we’ll win this race — by sharing our stories, lifting each other up, and being fierce enough to fight for the bright future New Mexicans deserve. **[If you can, I’d be grateful if you’d split a $10 donation between my campaign for governor and State Democrats Committee today. | | My Fellow American,Communities across America remain overwhelmed by millions of illegal aliens President Biden waved across the border. The biased media keeps flooding our airwaves with open borders propaganda.And billionaires like George Soros are propping up Leftist NGOS, radical activists, and political puppets to advance the globalist, anti-American agenda of the oligarchs.They want to keep all of Biden’s illegal aliens in this country and turn America into a socialist “Open Society.” For the past fifty years, they’ve undermined American workers, American culture, and the American Dream...But I’m not writing today just to tell you about how open borders have hurt hard-working Americans.You already know that. I’m writing to tell you about the organization that is poised to put the screws to these open borders politicians and reshape the entire public discussion around immigration.That organization is **[**NumbersUSA.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=bd35adf9621a4966abc87d0f1f846039&_e=Rai5VNPu9xuF5O3hin9nWIEGJxGS7yADVUzjiBxoCGblFz5hBHXsg9DQKEN5m0OV20Uc2E-n5Bg54zVIYHLqN07D7-ZDF2Xjz58EUdwBtQOF_IJyuGaXR20wsP44i3Xrhwk6aY-1ycYJiOm_Gn7A0uayWrdZuNCLz4bJ3pkvnadb9O1JyUuXaRKUvMLYOWzMhoV62aDhSSa9siNyF7bSBBfBkWEruRNRthQnXVasqNOYiB82tn-2t6dk-Ml4H1pmf_XMBc7oqAU_lEKA6Nc7Q7shzfw9LMDt9d2TQdOKXq5gC112H_3CRC1oXqCWVx2yzD0asftARLhb99inON56TQkurt6fyf_mj74bLiDMWF4%3D)** You may not have heard of them before, but since I took office in 2013, I’ve seen time after time how powerful they are in exerting public pressure on wishy-washy politicians.**NumbersUSA** harnesses the power of over 8 million grassroots members all focused on one issue: immigration.They are the voice on Capitol Hill for an America-first immigration agenda.And they grade every member of Congress to show who truly puts America first on immigration and who just talks a big game on the campaign trail. I’m honored that, after twelve years of service, **NumbersUSA** calculates I’ve earned an “A” on my career immigration report card. This sort of pressure and public accountability are vital if we want to execute President Trump’s immigration agenda. You see, many of my colleagues don’t have deeply held convictions like you, me, and President Trump.They just go whichever way the political winds blow.That’s why the Radical Left has dominated this issue from as far back as I can remember. They’ve outraised us...They’ve outspent us...And then they’ve strong-armed spineless officials into selling out the American people.Frankly, if we want to take our country back, we need **NumbersUSA** to rally American patriots from across our great land. That’s why I wanted to drop in this little note today to accompany the letter from Roy Beck, the founder of **NumbersUSA**.He’ll tell you all about the wonderful work they’re doing, and I’d ask you to consider supporting them however you see fit. We have a narrow window to make a difference, and we need your help now more than ever. God Bless you and God Bless America!
---
**Senator Ted Cruz** for **NumbersUSA**

low-level judges are saying, Birthright Citizenship for tourists and illegal aliens is not written into the Constitution.Rather, the 14th Amendment that contains Birthright Citizenship was enacted to grant full citizenship to the slaves freed by Abraham Lincoln — along with their children and their children’s children. It was not meant to apply to foreign visitors...**And it was _definitely not_ for illegal aliens.**In fact, the text of the 14th Amendment clearly states that it only applies to “persons born or naturalized in the United States, **_AND_** subject to the jurisdiction thereof.” But over time, government bureaucrats stretched the 14th Amendment and automatically gave U.S. citizenship to every birth to illegal aliens, and even to foreign nationals vacationing in the United States.Now, the situation has gotten completely out of hand...**In 2023 alone, there were roughly 350,000 births to illegal aliens in the U.S. Tourists gave birth to another 40,000.** These so-called “anchor babies” can keep illegal alien parents from getting deported and give a legal basis for a whole chain of migrants to push their way into America.Is it any surprise that human traffickers and even high-end birth tourism companies are making billions of dollars?This is not by accident – it’s by design. In fact, the Obama State Department changed U.S. visa rules to explicitly allow women to travel to America for the purpose of giving birth in 2015!Thankfully, the Trump administration overturned this rule and pushed back on illegal immigration on a number of fronts.**_But Trump can’t do it alone._**

**Fortunately, grassroots organizing is what NumbersUSA does best.** Over the past thirty years, we’ve grown from a small staff into the largest single-issue advocacy group in the United States.Back in 1996, we pioneered the tactic of masses of grassroots voters faxing elected officials directly. In 2007, when Ted Kennedy (remember him?) was trying to grant amnesty to millions of illegal aliens, NumbersUSA mobilized citizens in such numbers that they shut down the Congressional switchboard.The New York Times “blamed” NumbersUSA as the key factor in blocking Kennedy’s decades-long mass amnesty dream.It was a real David-and-Goliath struggle, and we won. Fast forward to 2025, and our populist immigration position is gaining traction in Washington.The DC power brokers are now calling us when they need to mobilize America-First patriots across the country.To be clear, that’s not because they want to talk to me, Roy Beck. It’s because they know that NumbersUSA is the connection point for 8 million members who understand how our immigration system is utterly broken......and what it will take to fix it.We’ve never had a President like Donald Trump who gets this issue on such a visceral level. But it takes more than just one man to reverse this open borders insanity. He needs a lot of congressional action to back him up and to make improvements permanent.**In our decades on Capitol Hill, we have learned that nothing grabs attention like fired-up American patriots just like you.** And there’s no denying the impact when a mountain of responses pours in from across the country.It proves that the immigration action we’re calling for isn’t just coming from me, or the great folks at NumbersUSA, or even Senator Ted Cruz—**no, it’s the unmistakable _DEMAND _of the American people.**And at that point, a politician doesn’t need one ounce of courage. | Dear friends,
Serving as your State Senator is a privilege, and my commitment goes beyond representations of our community. My goal is to keep you well-informed and engaged in the latest developments in Lansing and our district. Stay tuned for updates, as transparency is of utmost importance to me. With each passing day is another opportunity to work towards bringing back a Republican Senate majority. I appreciate your ongoing support, and I am grateful for the opportunity to keep working hard for our community.
---
|
---
| **Standing with Families, Fighting for Answers**
I’m standing with parents, health experts, and bipartisan allies to demand action on PFAS. Too many families have been left in the dark about their kids’ exposure to these toxic “forever chemicals.” That ends now.
I’ve introduced legislation to provide free PFAS blood testing for children in the hardest-hit communities—because every parent deserves answers and peace of mind. This is about clean water, public health, and basic justice. Doctors will help families understand the results, and a statewide research effort will guide long-term solutions. We won’t stop until every child gets the care and answers they deserve.
Click [here](https://brightsparkstrategies.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f3a7dccdb3ca90c7483cf93d3&id=f022935a2f&e=9ec31248a9) to read more.
---
|
---
|
### **Fighting for a Smarter, Fairer State Budget**

This week, I opposed the Senate’s fiscal year 2026 budget because it grows government instead of solving real problems for Michigan families. West Michigan taxpayers deserve a budget that respects their hard-earned dollars—not one that raises taxes while ignoring student achievement, crumbling roads, and everyday kitchen-table concerns. Just 25% of Michigan’s fourth graders are reading at grade level, yet this plan offers no real solutions to help our kids succeed.
I offered common-sense amendments to widen M-11 in Walker, invest $1 billion in local road repairs, and give families relief—every single one was rejected. Lansing can and must do better. I’ll keep fighting for a budget that puts families first, fixes roads, and delivers real results.
---
|
---
| **Thank You!**
Your efforts are truly impactful. By contributing, you’re helping us advocate for the changes and reforms our community needs. Every donation, no matter the size, fuels our mission and ensures a brighter future for all. Join us in shaping a better tomorrow; donate today!

name: Randy Bryce
subject: The Iron Stache is back

body:
It’s Randy Bryce: You might remember me as the “Iron Stache,” the union Ironworker, veteran, and Democrat who took on Paul Ryan and helped escort him out the door.
| Peter,

It’s Randy Bryce: You might remember me as the “Iron Stache,” the union Ironworker, veteran, and Democrat who took on Paul Ryan and helped escort him out the door.

You were an important part of the movement we started to build in 2018, but we have more work to do. That’s why I’ve officially launched my campaign for Congress in Wisconsin’s 1st Congressional District against MAGA crony and Paul Ryan protege, Bryan Steil.

Take a look at my launch video, “Job’s Not Done,” and let me know what you think:
---
[](https://fight4progress.org/l/PG6bvXAx6fsy)
| [ WATCH HERE ](https://fight4progress.org/l/7at4EQ4HYh5v)
---
Let’s be honest: There’s a war on the Middle Class and it didn’t start with Trump - but it sure is getting worse. With the help of yes-men like Steil, the billionaires are winning and on the backs of working people.

As our jobs continue to be shipped overseas, wages still stagnant, and unions are gutted, Trump and Steil continue to attack what’s left of the American Dream. They are coming for our healthcare, our retirement, and our public schools.

_**I couldn’t stand by and watch the problems facing the Middle Class continue to get worse while Bryan Steil sits back and does nothing - except keep voting to let it happen. So I decided to throw my hat back in the ring and show them what we can do together.**_

I’ve spent my life on construction sites – not in backrooms with lobbyists. I don’t have a trust fund. I’ve beaten back cancer. I’ve taken care of a sick parent. I’ve served my country in the Army. I know what it means to struggle – and I know what it means to fight.

Bryan Steil has sold us out to the billionaires.

He’s voted to rip away healthcare from seniors and the disabled. He’s stood by while MAGA extremists tore apart our farm economy, wrecked our supply chains, and pushed tax breaks for the ultra-rich, all while plotting to SLASH Medicare, Medicaid and Social Security.

Me? I’m in construction, not demolition. And I believe in building something that lasts:
— Jobs with dignity
— Healthcare as a human right FOR EVERYONE
— And PROTECTING Social Security, Medicaid, and Medicare from destruction

But I can’t do this alone. This campaign is powered by people, not Super PACs. That’s how we took on Paul Ryan. And it’s how we’re going to defeat Bryan Steil.

Make no mistake about it, this IS a winnable seat. This is a battleground district that is moving our way, and people are FED UP with Steil.

_**If Democrats want to retake the House, flipping WI-01 is the BEST place to start.**_

[_**Can you make a donation RIGHT NOW to my campaign and Fight for Progress so we can build this thing from the ground up? We’ve set an ambitious goal of adding 200 Grassroots Donors before midnight tonight – and I’m counting on you to help us get there. $25, $50, or even $100 will help us start this campaign on the right foot.**_](https://fight4progress.org/bryce?t=BcAVUpQYpuPt&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-05-29_1&amount=25)
| [ BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR >> ](https://fight4progress.org/bryce?t=mzWLXtsF9r3m&refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2025-05-29_1&amount=25)
---
The other side has the billionaires. But we’ve got each other, and we’ve got the people-powered coalition that’s going to make history.

And if we stick together? There’s not a damn thing we can’t do.

Thanks for believing in this campaign.

In solidarity,
Randy “Iron Stache” Bryce
* * *

The Detroit & Michigan NLG Chapter trains Legal Observers who attend demonstrations around the state to monitor law enforcement behavior toward activists. They work with NLG attorneys to share information that can help activists in court and to coordinate arrest support for activists. Legal Observers also often deter police violence by being present.
Fighting against police brutality for decades, the Detroit & Michigan Chapter of the National Lawyers Guild has provided Legal Observers and jail support for the Ferguson Uprising and the George Floyd uprising. In 2020, Legal Observers from the Detroit & Michigan Chapter showed up for over 100 consecutive days of racial justice marches in Detroit and at many protests in other parts of Michigan.
The group coordinated legal support and defense for over 400 protesters around the state and won a Preliminary Injunction against the Detroit police’s abuses of protesters, leading to a ruling that the City of Detroit and the Detroit Police Department violated the constitutional rights of protesters. An important victory for the movement!
As organizers from Palestine Solidarity Grand Rapids said at a recent event with the Detroit & Michigan Chapter of the National Lawyer's Guild, _“knowing that networks like the NLG exist and that Legal Observers have our backs at actions make the work safer and give us the support we need to be in the streets fighting for justice.”_
Now the Detroit & Michigan NLG Chapter is fighting back against the Trump administration’s attacks on our communities, including speaking out for transgender and intersex American citizens in opposition to the administration’s changes to gender markers on passports.
The NLG Detroit & Michigan Chapter does all this with just two part-time staff members, a team of volunteer attorneys and Legal Observers, and often limited funds.

I wanted to take a moment to share why I first ran for Congress. I hope you’ll read this message in its entirety, then **[consider making a $3 donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108601712/548443651/1606932672?refcode=em-5.29.25-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjM0Y2E0NC1jZDNjLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aJvEJ1ip2DdwDA_H7soBA4IkoTcOpezHRTLMJoOCLhw=)** to keep me in Washington fighting for you.

When I take a step back and remember why I decided to run to flip CA-27 blue, and why I’m already gearing up for re-election, I think of my family – specifically, my daughter Maya.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108601713/548443652/1606932672?refcode=em-5.29.25-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZjM0Y2E0NC1jZDNjLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aJvEJ1ip2DdwDA_H7soBA4IkoTcOpezHRTLMJoOCLhw=)
I’ll never forget the day, eight years ago now, that Maya came home from kindergarten telling me about her day. Instead of telling me about a fun activity she did, she recalled the “exercises” she’d done with her classmates.

**She didn’t quite grasp the concept at the time, but she was describing an active shooter drill.**

That moment continues to have a profound impact on me – both as a father and now as a Congressman. We live in a country where for some families, a hug goodbye before school or work, a concert, a movie, a church service could be the last.

**Despite this reality, some of my extreme colleagues are still unwilling to make the common sense changes Americans desperately need to save lives.**

And it’s not just gun violence, Peter. We’ve seen women’s rights stripped away with the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_. Maya now has less control over her body than my wife and even my mom did at her age.

We have a lot of work ahead of us, and I’m so proud that we put together a grassroots coalition that flipped this seat. **With Republican control of Congress and the presidency, now is not the time to check out – it’s the time to dig in our heels and fight for what’s right.**

**[This district is already ranked as one of the most consequential races in the midterm elections. subject: Absolutely ridiculous
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Somebody who does not deserve a parade is Donald Trump. He’s shredding the Constitution and taking a sledgehammer to the programs and services veterans depend on.
#

Team, I served our country for 25 years. Deployed all over the world. Flew in combat. Made nearly 400 successful carrier landings.
So, I think I can say this with a little authority: Nobody in the military _really_ likes doing parades. They're almost always on a holiday, or what should be a day off. You’ve got to make sure your uniform is perfect. You’re marching in formation all day.
But, I get it. They’re fun for people. They’re a good way for people to get closer to the military. To see the folks serving our country, up close, and to show our appreciation for them. They deserve to be celebrated.
Somebody who does **_not**_ deserve a parade is Donald Trump. He’s shredding the Constitution and taking a sledgehammer to the programs and services veterans depend on. And after all he’s done, he’s got the nerve to co-opt the Army’s 250th anniversary and make it his own birthday parade?
It’s a disgrace, honestly.
If there’s anything I can do to prevent Trump from taking that special day and making it all about himself, I’m going to do it.

#
Peter - please, don’t click away before reading.
When we think about the people who have done the most to support VoteVets over the years, it’s not the people who write the biggest checks who come to mind.
It’s the people who were there when everything was on the line.
Like you, Peter.

Your support, voice, and participation have helped us run some of the most powerful and impactful ads out there. It has helped us continue to be one of the most impactful and effective organizations in politics, even with all that Trump throws our way.
Your support helps us win races that otherwise wouldn’t even be competitive.
It’s helped us fight for things that matter most to Veterans. It has stopped more efforts to privatize the VA than we can count. It won things like the PACT Act, ensuring Veterans suffering from toxic exposures could get the treatment they need and deserve.
And now, it’s a huge part of how we are fighting back against Trump and Doug Collins as they work to dismantle the VA, piece by piece.

But here’s an interesting fact: out of almost 2 million people who have taken action with VoteVets, only 1% have made a donation online to support our work.
Today, we’re asking you to join that select group.

Our average donation is $25. Some give more, many give less. But with Trump coming for everything we hold dear, all that matters is that you’re choosing to power our work with a donation.
We’ll put it right to work fighting and fighting back against these liars and hypocrites, and defending our Constitution at a moment when it is in extreme peril.

We know that hyperpartisanship and extremism do nothing to make our streets safer or lower everyday costs for working families. Friends, _“That’s the way militaries work in Russia and China and North Korea.”_ In a new POLITICO [feature](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/108604018/548451030/430244531?refcode=250529_Seth_MFC_HowDemocracyCrumbles&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MGZkZWU0Yi1kMjNjLWYwMTEtYTVmMS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1qwjdyZxOTgD4nQnr5Hw9bgMkclp-0V3ZpqCg1MksS0=&emci=fc6051f6-aa3c-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&emdi=90fdee4b-d23c-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=194769), Seth Moulton is again calling out Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s plan to purge a sweeping number of high-ranking military officers with seemingly no explanation. Now more than ever, we need leaders in Congress who are strong on national security, know how our military works, and how high the stakes are. And here’s the thing: the more Seth speaks out, the more of a target he becomes. Reports are already circulating that potential opponents are lining up to challenge Seth. The far right sees his voice — his courage — as a threat. And they want to silence it. We can’t let that happen. We won’t let that happen. But we’re facing a critical end-of-month deadline, and we still have ground to cover to hit our fundraising goal. We need to show that grassroots supporters have Seth’s back — because the stakes are too high to sit this one out. **💡 ****Support Michigan’s rail and clean energy projects** to help create jobs while lowering emissions and strengthening our rural communities.

**Why Democrats Keep Losing Races They Absolutely Can Win**
This week on _Amped Up_ , Cliff is joined by Reid Galen, co-founder of the Lincoln Project and former GOP strategist, to drop a truth bomb on the Democratic Party's chronic messaging problems. From tone-deaf campaign slogans to not talking about jobs as a values-based proposition, Reid, Cliff & co-host David Shuster explain why "not Trump" isn't enough.
_**Democrats must fight like hell and connect with voters where they live, work, breathe.** _We can't keep losing those who despise Trump, think GOP policies are insane, but also haven't met/talked with a Democrat on a peer-to-peer level. Or seen Democratic messaging to counter constant GOP conspiracies and lies pipelined into local right-wing-talk radio, Sinclair tv stations, FoxNews, cultural influencers, podcasts, etc.
**This conversation got** _**very**_**real about:**
* The myth of polite politics--and why it's killing Democrats
* Why people aren't uninformed, but unimpressed [Ed Note: Here there was some disagreement. Blue Amp believes for the reasons mentioned above, voters are also often uninformed about the horrid/insane things Trump has said and/or done
* The GOP's ruthless infrastructure machine--from local to national programming, online & offline, think tanks & media orgs--_and how Dems need their own_
* The need for emotional, values-based messaging that doesn't reek of sanctimony, but clearly explains the contrast between who Democrats and Republicans are
* And yes, how to weaponize Trump's tariffs against the GOP--clean water and all!

I periodically share this more personal side of my advocacy for human rights because it is important to me that you, my gracious supporters, see what I see. ## How It Started
As a human rights lawyer, I have always been relentless in my calls to protect due process of law. Due process is the last line of defense between a functioning republic and a deteriorating dictatorship. When I learned that Trump's advisor Stephen Miller is floating the idea of suspending Habeas Corpus, I loudly and clearly condemned the very suggestion itself.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a0b279ee-dd3a-45c7-92cb-152a1ca3fc70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Unfortunately, the Overton Window has already shifted enough that MAGA cultists seem quite alright with the idea of shredding our Constitution and denying people due process of law. This is, to say it bluntly, horrifying for the future of our nation, and requires that we raise our voices loudly to hold the line and protect due process for all people in this country. Here are just a snapshot of the responses to me daring to demand due process of law.

Here’s a key fact that not many people know about California’s governor election next year: **a recent poll showed that 48% of California voters are considering voting for a Republican.**
Republicans are hoping they can leverage this not only to flip our state government, but also to win Congressional races to solidify their House majority.

## Trump's tariffs are back in business
A federal appeals court **[blocked a lower court ruling](https://substack.com/redirect/595f1115-6372-41a8-89d2-c3fda0957fa5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that would have overturned most of Trump's tariffs, giving the White House a temporary victory while the appeal is heard.
The original Court of International Trade had ruled Trump exceeded his authority by imposing 10% tariffs on dozens of countries, plus higher rates on Canada, Mexico, and China over fentanyl trafficking.
The White House had threatened to ask the Supreme Court for "emergency relief" as soon as Friday if the appeals court didn't intervene, with officials arguing the lower court judges "brazenly abused their judicial power" and were undermining U.S. credibility on the world stage. Trade adviser Peter Navarro said the stay won't affect ongoing negotiations with other countries.
Even if the tariffs face legal challenges, analysts from Morgan Stanley and Goldman Sachs noted Trump has multiple legal authorities to maintain most tariff levels, including Section 232 national security provisions for steel, aluminum, and auto imports that weren't affected by the court ruling. As one analyst put it, "there are so many different authorities the administration can reach into to put it back together."

## Trump to send $9.4 billion DOGE rescission package to congress as soon as Monday: report
The White House will send Congress its first DOGE rescission bill as early as Monday, targeting $9.4 billion in cuts to what **[Budget Director Russ Vought calls "waste and garbage."](https://substack.com/redirect/51e6488a-d10a-4dde-ac3e-d1ec0d799a3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The bill focuses on foreign aid, USAID ($8.3 billion), the Corporation for Public Broadcasting and NPR ($1.1 billion), and other programs deemed wasteful.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/2326314f-9f09-4886-8053-9f3734cb813d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The bill only needs a simple majority in both the House and Senate to pass and can avoid the Senate filibuster, giving Republicans a clear procedural advantage. Vought expressed confidence that both chambers will work with the administration to get the cuts into law.
Once Congress receives the package, lawmakers have exactly 45 days to vote on clawing back the funding. House Speaker Mike Johnson said the House is "eager and ready to act" and will move quickly to pass legislation codifying the cuts.
This represents the first concrete legislative action from DOGE's work, with Vought indicating more rescission bills will follow if Congress passes this initial package. The administration is being strategic about using procedural opportunities that have the best chance of actually becoming law rather than getting bogged down in political fights.

It's Thursday, time for another amazing panel show. Joining me today is Stephen Gardner, Ashley Hayek and David Avella to unpack everything that happened in Washington this week. Elon says goodbye to DOGE as his time as a special government employee comes to an end. With Elon at the helm, DOGE uncovered shocking amounts of waste, fraud and abuse that was hidden from the American people. Will the department see the same results with someone else taking charge? The U.S. Court of International Trade blocked President Trump's global tariff plan he used under emergency economic powers. It's a speed bump in the Trump agenda but certainly a fight that is not over. President Trump won a libel suit against the Pulitzer Prize Board as a judge ruled in his favor on the Russia hoax perpetrated against him. It seems the Pulitzer Prize Board would rather reward fake news than promote real journalism. The House Oversight Committee is calling top Biden aides to testify on the use of the autopen and if Biden had a clue what was happening. The Republican litmus test is happening today as voting takes place to defund PBS & NPR. After Rep. Brandon Gill exposed the left-wing propaganda taking place at both PBS & NPR it should be an easy vote. It was another action-packed week and our panel has the winners and losers for you!

body:
-It all started in a garage with no budget and a dream. -You didn't just believe in us. You built us. -From one spark to a nationwide fire. -You helped make the impossible possible. -What started small is now shaking campuses across America. -This is what a real youth revolution looks like. -Because of you, the tide is turning. -See what you helped unleash on the campuses they said we'd never reach. -We were never supposed to be winning--and yet here we are. -One dream. One vision. A whole new generation rising. -You were there from the beginning--even if you didn't know it. -Let me show you what you helped ignite. -This fire's not going out anytime soon. -We're about to go further than we ever thought possible. -Thanks to you, we're lighting up the map. -This is the cultural shift you prayed for. -What we're building together is bigger than you think. -This isn't nostalgia--it's mission fuel. -When they said we'd fail, you said "go." -Let's make this a turning point for history.

| | | [](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/oSUeCggSXGiYdXoYNde5ngjB-0F1iBgcXCJ4ZzrJSWiHPxH9pdo1cjuWZx0aXZUubDyYg7H2nH9kDa4MIZJcnlDYSp-E__Z3susLCpmDTXw8A9LpGCd8uGVZf2s1ilXO4tRO_BHkAPhicvwXjTg3wBxKHJpz6isqDcHJ2XafsEhdsLKEx8Yi1jzN4CPup8Gv4HHIrH2f_oBpvu8J4V17ttyRwWs-8j3aClJ4N_bnPKBvF3y7zsAE--d5s0Rw2BaZepAC3BQ1ITvwunnEJ1xhlcRu1zDC9rlc0nmhw1IYUPo_hiH1vlz74mnDIcJ--Gvit4ElBXYcEtRoAgUzEW1UtyC3YPmLIFjKnHNNzzyQ3Eh1dm4aM9Qb9k4J25Qw2XC5yneMmo46pDfi3bbIe4pwGlMFRKIJ9a2x4wDhfXYAH-HPpbNoEt0m0-ObzgXHOuYGH_keJ9op5m3tNXrNpA/IBqPf5L405WpnPslVQ6HJpZZIrl6heXW/9)
---
Peter, We recently wrapped up one of Turning Point USA's latest stops on the American Comeback Tour at UC San Diego... I wish you could have been there to see it. Another packed quad. Students eager to listen. Flags waving. Cheers for America. Energy you could feel in your bones. _Not in Texas... Not in Florida..._ **_California._** The "Deep Blue" stronghold the Left said we'd never touch. But we did. And we'll keep going. **Because of patriots like you.**
---
[](http://links.conservativeum.com/s/c/HKIy_ByQQ9msI-Ui2jjhVIBcnjWsByrYRqFNu6eMlXrbF6vb3D8ouDgni71wdY8TOZlsw-OLXFvqv-gQQgL9k1m24kPhRJHi2h8r_HIthVASSc4fH47BTP0uegWODLa-IbMQOvHgaBX5reQAHQyo9Hmxo1NAzpNm6bIaPWJlzls0fHtzidQwfMlMbpVWN6CO4QLPXjDhGBbb_WJaxRg4ZGlbcC639o83iE4QjIZs_spceSoW802ERwrw39f4PBomvh_mpDXk4_aND8dxHs3uLvHi9Ws2XQi1-_Jab1ZjXKXOgtP9lkW1N-xVPgF38pwuWxWP21_KDH3w0HPxxV5NLm9FW5BlSc7Z_cgcugsu5ZspAgy9n8GeYKSD-AY5jTbrQzty4cXDuyAzWbgqp9RtYhwURT0GSP7JR3BrXtumF6-UIccdWljit66GKGwI0V6epJGOEw9ceWrINh9H-g/15sfmoY9yjDZo-vevSMNR2Kx4Ir6ynkI/9)
---
As I stood there looking out at the crowd -- hundreds of young patriots rising up in a place the Left said they owned -- I couldn't help but think... **Nearly 13 years ago, all of this felt...****_impossible._** Back then, Turning Point USA wasn't the cultural phenomenon it is today.It wasn't an office. body:

Friends -
President Trump’s unlawful tariffs are wreaking chaos on California families, businesses, and our economy — driving up prices and threatening jobs.
That is why California filed a lawsuit to stop Trump's tariffs.
**Last night, a court agreed with the legal theory behind our case and ordered a reversal of the tariffs.**
**[Here's a short video update I recorded earlier today. Please watch:](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/go/4194?t=1&akid=2341%2E4767699%2EfZwkfW)**

California is the largest manufacturing and agricultural state in the country as well as one of the largest trading partners around the globe.
No state has been, or will be, more impacted than California when it comes to the unilateral and illegal authority being asserted by the Trump administration to impose the largest and most regressive tax increase in modern American history.
Make no mistake, this case will likely end up in the Supreme Court and we will remain vigilant in pushing back against all of this Trump created chaos.
Thank you for reading,
Gavin Newsom

disclaimer_text: Paid for by United for Democracy
body:
The Trump administration is trying to deport people to countries they’ve never set foot in. The Supreme Court must do the right thing. | |
---
Peter, Trump isn’t stopping at deporting 100 Venezuelans to El Salvador. Now, he’s trying to send eight migrants to South Sudan—a country on the brink of civil war that these people do not come from and have never set foot in before. **A federal judge has already ordered the administration not to turn the migrants over to South Sudan. Trump’s asking the Supreme Court to let him do it anyway.** On Tuesday, the administration sent an appeal to the Supreme Court asking them to halt the court order allowing the migrants to challenge their deportations to South Sudan. **Trump is running to his MAGA friends on the Roberts court, hoping they’ll give him cover for his authoritarian activity.** He’s not looking for an appeal. He’s looking for a cleanup crew. Trump has already violated due process rights by shipping immigrants abroad to countries they have no connections to with no hearings, no translators, and no notice to their lawyers until it’s too late. Now, he wants to violate federal law prohibiting the government from deporting people to countries where their safety may be in question. [**The Supreme Court has the opportunity to put an end to Trump’s oppressive deportation regime right here and now. Add your name today. Tell the Roberts court to do the right thing and deny Trump’s appeal.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39xlBV8K-h1SPh5Rb04hGqQtFus7OLN2RG0VUDT0Xix4p24OrQVDDme9_ieRYSeBEV6Xo9vreuTY4F1X-3jm2QrVjI0MImggFQrI34NWnXiuHQmrWTZ35R8qu3BAIZmh1Tmo3NpvKaFIa2H-v4lMDsYNG6LMkBlrp4041TaeD7T7cvMxU2ji-ovrntEO-sU8ksiaitK1rKPP7CK_HyuoDodfnyZzxS-svEBFEoGdF_wZDSrqIjtaWOU8VJbAQ_jCoNjGbO07FwWBOhkvvWEVxSwZ6GDuMKlAYOKyys1MmJQsmdCKuYmhOsH16Ay0gFaDI8a6k4dwBm33xIwpMGr_8ogR-Sb9RSgQxhG7vg2mKfndA/4gw/ljiNbPXzQseBXIeixLgzXw/h0/h001.DzqpqS9rx_zkIZEvUY3pjUv_pj7T5tDuIIL3Nj9fGJA) [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39xlBV8K-h1SPh5Rb04hGqQtFus7OLN2RG0VUDT0Xix4p24OrQVDDme9_ieRYSeBEV6Xo9vreuTY4F1X-3jm2QrVjI0MImggFQrI34NWnXiuCTyJfcmSLOQF3Kx-WGYEEow71i6GZuNv3AJ-gbPh-qtixiCyZYPBjknxxOcL4Kp1xOhYpUKvExHJfy7JjpacVPh7TZztuMBJ5f0LVHLJk_2ahwtsVHDeOzSO5dS55XZKqq_sA6ceH1kZ5F5zeAXFTKctw4IUqBD5IdEFp7_26k7F0UxGsgENKk4PFrxIG9aF7G2eH6-XGkepDvNUUkEk4dWat1TLLvCpiM1SmXepGLjWA74Zye0nRSVkmGP8kfE3w/4gw/ljiNbPXzQseBXIeixLgzXw/h1/h001.yOoa9kdaKcmmaXeImlSBLyYUilcjYtearUNTlW4MDKU) Trump is claiming that because these eight migrants have criminal records, that they don’t deserve due process. **But in America, a criminal conviction does not mean you lose your basic rights to due process or habeas corpus—and Trump doesn’t get to pick and choose who deserves fundamental rights.** A family member of one of the migrants’ victims said it best: “If we consent to ignore the fundamental rights of some people, then who is to say these rights will apply to us and who decides when and for whom rights apply?”1 The federal judge who blocked Trump’s deportations to South Sudan has threatened criminal penalties for the officials who put the migrants on a flight to Africa anyway. But in America, a criminal conviction does not mean you lose your basic rights to due process or habeas corpus—and Trump doesn’t get to pick and choose who deserves fundamental rights. A family member of one of the migrants’ victims said it best: “If we consent to ignore the fundamental rights of some people, then who is to say these rights will apply to us and who decides when and for whom rights apply?”1 The federal judge who blocked Trump’s deportations to South Sudan has threatened criminal penalties for the officials who put the migrants on a flight to Africa anyway. That’s exactly what the Supreme Court must do, too. Trump’s deportation regime is what authoritarian immigration policy looks like: secret flights, black sites, and no rights. Thank you for fighting to defend our rights, Meagan Hatcher-Mays United for Democracy 1 Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . Right now, Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress are pushing an agenda that would make deep cuts to Medicaid, Social Security, and other essential programs that millions of Americans count on — including families right here in CA-25. They want to slash Medicaid, Social Security, and other critical services — putting the needs of everyday families behind the wealth of Donald Trump and his billionaire friends. And as a physician, **I take that personally**. These programs are lifelines — helping people afford medications, see a doctor, care for aging parents, and put food on the table. Gutting them would have real, devastating consequences for our communities. Trump promised to protect these programs. But now, he and his allies are putting the wealth of billionaires and corporate donors ahead of the basic needs of everyday Americans. And we can’t let them get away with it. I **_won’t_** let them get away with it. We have a critical opportunity to stop this agenda by flipping the House in 2026. And that work starts now — in critical districts like CA-25. The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _
